title: My gratitude knows no bounds
text:
Zane Jagger: V, I can't thank you enough – my gratitude together with a discount in the package. Stop by Jinguji and we'll choose something nova for you. Even now if you want. Or maybe in an hour? Don't keep me in your debt longer than necessary.
Zane Jagger: By the way, do you have a sweet tooth for gossip? I found some veeery interesting detes about the MaxTac officer that questioned us.
V [choice]: Hit me.
V [choice]: Hm, appreciate the offer, but I don't like stickin my nose in other people's biz...
Zane Jagger: Your restraint is admirable. Honorable, even. But I can't abide by it. Information – even in gossip-form – is the secret to success, survival and fulfillment – broadly defined.
V [choice]: Shit, and here I thought I was the cynical one...
V [choice]: Fine, have it your way. Spill.
Zane Jagger: What can I say – you have to be cynical to be successful!
Zane Jagger: Oh, and if you ever need a cozy nook to bathe in elegance, don't forget to stop by Jinguji!
Zane Jagger: I couldn't help thinking I saw her somewhere, so I checked the N54 News archive and whaddaya know! She was a CYBERPSYCHO! On Jan. 14 she killed 14 people!
Zane Jagger: Her name's Melissa Rory. They reconditioned her and forced her to join the MaxTac. Ironic twist of fate, right?
V [choice]: No shit. And they're not scared she might fly off the handle again? She seemed weirdly... excited about that bloodbath in the store...
V [choice]: Meh. Doesn't surprise me. Who'd know a cyberpsycho better than someone who gets a kick outta slaughtering people?
Zane Jagger: As long as she protects me against psychos, she can get a kick out of anything for all I care. Anyway, see you in my bastion of Taste and Refinement.

A lethal miracle of technology. In exchange the device will stream data to us. This will not affect your life in any way. Or rather your attempts at staying alive. We have transmitted coordinates.

V [choice]: Why should I trust you?
V [choice]: Fuck off. Remove me from your database, calling list or whatever and never contact me again
V [choice]: That's all fine and dandy. But what's the catch?
UNKNOWN NUMBER: We think you know. And if you do not, then that should not be your worry. It is one of the billions of scraps of information preventing you from taking action. What matters is what we offer you now – technology that nobody else has access to.
UNKNOWN NUMBER: You've made up your mind. Rightly so. Take good care of our gift. Get to know one another, help one another. You may be living on borrowed time, but your future is looking ever so slightly brighter. Good luck, V.
UNKNOWN NUMBER: We understand that this emotional reaction comes from your limited cognitive abilities. We are not forcing you to do anything. Even if it is for your own good. If and when you decide to seize this opportunity, a netrunner will await you.
UNKNOWN NUMBER: We do not expect your trust. Trust if needed when the unknown is at play. Here, everything is self-evident. Can you truly not see that? This arrangement is of benefit to both parties.
UNKNOWN NUMBER: There is no catch. You will grant us access to data from your reality. In exchange you will acquire technology that will allow you to better use the time you have left. It is a generous offer.
UNKNOWN NUMBER: You surprise us, V. Your uncertainty, hesitation, your indecisiveness. A piece of unique technology rests at your fingertips. You know precisely how to unlock its potential. What is it you wait for?
UNKNOWN NUMBER: You hesitate. We can cannot comprehend it. Why do you not choose the optimal outcome? You are in no position to turn down such a gift.
UNKNOWN NUMBER: Idleness is wasted potential. Disappointment. If you do not intend to use the chipset, it would be best to free yourself ot it. SELL IT.
V [choice]: Haven't decided what I'll do with it yet.
V [choice]: Yeaaah, no thanks. This stinks worse than Coronado Bay
UNKNOWN NUMBER: V... We know you took some interesting items with you from the heart of darkness. Prototype crafting blueprints developed in Cynosure, a rare chipset with even rarer anomalies... title: Need your expertise
text:
V [choice]: You ever hear of a sitch where a BD user gets stuck believin they're still the other person even after takin off the wreath?
V [choice]: Hey so, hypothetically, say someone has trouble returning to their normal self after using a BD… that like a problem? Scale of 1 to 10
V: New choom of mine had an accident recently. A localnet power surge overloaded his wreath and toasted the circuits.  Guy's been livin his life thinking he's this BD star ever since
Viktor Vektor: Like a magnet for the weirdest shit in the city, aren't you?
Viktor Vektor: Well, I'm no psychiatrist but this is ringing a bell from back when I was still cutting my teeth as a fledgling ripper. In those days it was known in the field as "induced identity". I remember it got some buzz in the 50s too, some kinda issue with the wreaths of the time. A number of those patients still haven't recovered.
Viktor Vektor: Cases have been common enough to be decently well documented. As far as treatment, psychotherapy's had some success - pharmaceuticals not so much. The key is inducing cognitive dissonance in the patient. By exposing them to something personal from their true reality, you undermine the adopted one. Or so the theory goes. It's worth keeping in mind though that patients in such an unstable state exhibit high mental plasticity, making them susceptible to suggestion and manipulation. So watch your words - they're likely to take anything you say at face value, potentially further reinforcing their adopted identity.
V [choice]: Reminds me of my own brain gettin scrambled from a BD once. Difference bein they woke up a star and I woke up in an scav icebath
Viktor Vektor: And it reminds me of someone I know running around town telling folks they're the second coming of some rockerboy dead fifty years

title: Fight Night
text:
Coach Fred: Alright, a couple words about who your goin up against:
1. Kabuki – wont spoil this :) just come and see
2. Arroyo – Buck, 6th Street ganger, real PoS
3. Glen – César. Fists like fckn hammers
4. Animals Club – Rhino. Woman's a legend, lays everyone flat
Coach Fred: Heard you whooped those twin freaks asses! ;) Good work, keep it up!
Coach Fred: Word on the street's that Buck needs some new teeth... Nicely done, V. I'm impressed
Coach Fred: Heard there was a real ugly mess with Buck... Guy was always shady. Glad you made it out in one piece.
Coach Fred: Well, well, thought César'd finally give you a run for your money, but you stood your ground. Who knows, maybe you'll end up in the finals?
Coach Fred: Word is you realigned César's face but let him keep the money. Nice gesture. He's a decent hombre, and that's a rare species in this town. Streets're reppin you up!
Coach Fred: Hey, another fight just landed on the schedule. It's in Pacifica, generatin huge buzz, not to mention huge cash. I know you can't resist ;)
Coach Fred: Heard that gonk's head fuckin EXPLODED?! Jesus, I just wish I'd seen it. You sure know how to please a crowd, V.
Coach Fred: Congrats on winning Pacifica :) Heard the other guy had a grenade instead of a nose? God I love Night City. This place is so fuckin WEIRD
Coach Fred: Hey, peeps kept on askin when they'd see your ass in the ring again, so I set up another fight – Pacifica this time. Huge buzz, huge cash... I hope I can count on you ;)
Coach Fred: YOU BEAT RHINO!?!? HOLY FUCK CONGRATZZZZ
Coach Fred: Heard things got ugly at the Animals joint? Fuck, you never know with those freaks. Hope you made it out in one piece
Coach Fred: Lemme say, V – I knew you'd go far... but I didn't think you'd get THIS far :) You're up in the finals against Razor Hughes – pro heavyweight champion. One of the best in the world – this fight'll go down in history, I can feel it!!!
Coach Fred: Fuck me... what a show. You're a legend, V. Thanks!!
Coach Fred: You really are a piece of work, V. I bent over fucking backwards for you – I found you, opened all the doors, and how do you repay me? By fucking me in the ASS. I'll make damn sure you never set foot in a ring again. Fucking gutter-trash.
Coach Fred: V – what if I told you that you could have some fun and make a little eddies in a single stroke? Fighting tournament's comin up – I think you've got what it takes. Flicking you the coords of your opponents. Money and fame're waiting ;)
Coach Fred: Oh, and one more thing – until the lockdown on Watson is lifted, you won't fight in any other districts. But don't worry – when things loosen up, you'll be the first to know.
Coach Fred: Yo, V! Watson's open now – you're a free woman! Just don't forget about the fights, alright? It'd be a shame not to put that talent of yours to good use.

text:
Coach Fred: Hey, V! Seems like the city swallowed you whole and you got no time for boxing no more, huh? But don't fret, I'm not one to hold a grudge. You could help me out with something tho. title: Lauren Costigan
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue Lauren Costigan from the Tyger Claws
Location: Building by Raymond St.
Details:

Old sins cast long shadows. And Bradley Costigan is guilty of many. As a result, he not only found himself in prison, but also invited trouble into the life of his wife, Lauren Costigan. It's your task to help her.

When Bradley landed a spot behind bars, he was contacted by old acquaintances in the Tyger Claws. Shiv some snitches, they said. He said no.

Tygers don't like that word. They kidnapped his wife and sent stills as proof. No great surprise, Bradley began to cooperate. But he also remembered me. He's promised payment and I believe he's desperate enough to be good for it.

My people have already tracked where the stills were taken. Once you have the coordinates, set to work immediately.
Wakako Okada: Lauren is secure – I am informing Bradley now. Thank you for your help. Contract closed.

title: Missing netrunner
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Locate netrunner Chang-Hoon Nam, 67 years old, regular associate
Location: Restaurant on Crescent St.
Details:

For years, I worked to get jobs done comfortably, with a crew I hand-picked myself. I chose Chang-Hoon Nam years ago, and he hasn't let me down once. I don't know what happened to him, but you must get him back. Check the basement in that Chinese place. He keeps his gear there, sometimes takes a side gig or two. I think he's still alive – if he weren't, he's the type who'd come back as a ghost and apologize, just like in those tales from the old country that make me want to puke. He's sentimental like that.
Wakako Okada: I was informed of how you handled yourself. Good work – I expected nothing less from you. I am closing the contract.

title: Bugging the shrine
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: Agent Saboteur
Objective: Place a wiretap in a Tyger Claw-controlled shrine
Location: Shinto shrine at Milagro Terrace
Details:

The person should not stray from the road and the tiger should not leave his mountain steppes. Or misfortune will find them both.

Tyger Claw boss Taki Kazo thinks he's smart. He thinks I won't find out about his agreement at the shinto shrine on Milagro Terrace. He thinks I don't know he's using the shrine's honden for secret meetings. He thinks he can rule Japantown without my influence. He will be wrong.

I'll give you a wiretap to place right at the shintai in the most sacred of shinto spaces. Don't make a noise. And don't disappoint me.
Wakako Okada: One more thing – you performed the task with flying colors and surpassed my expectations. You will find my additional reward at the drop point.
Wakako Okada: You were to do this quietly. It was anything but. The whole city heard what happened in the shrine. Your payment will reflect your carelessness. I am closing the contract.
Wakako Okada: You entered and left like a ghost, V. Nobody at the shrine even knew of your presence. Excellent work. Closing the contract and making the transfer.

title: CorpCracker
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: Search and Recovery
Objective: Retrieve Leah Gladen's lockbreaker device
Location: Building on the corner of Holly and Floyd St, door code 2137
Details:

A great treasure can turn out to be a great curse. Remember that, V.

One of the fences in my territory, Leah Gladen, came into possession of some highly valuable equipment – a lockbreak device capable of jailbreaking corp cyberware (some call it a CorpCracker). This tech opens doors for suits who want out but don't want to lose function of corp-issued chrome or are looking to make an extra eddie by selling secondhand.

Leah wasn't born yesterday. She knows what the tech is worth. She and I went back and forth, long price negotiations. We were close to reaching a deal when all contact was lost.

Your job is to find out what happened to Leah – but more importantly to get that skeleton key for me. Don't bother reporting back until you have it. Don't waste time.
Wakako Okada: I see you were able to find the lockbreaker. Splendid work – keep it up. Closing the contract.

title: Vulture's feast
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal Vortex's credchip
Location: Tyger Claws' casino on Longshore South
Details:

The vulture is the wisest bird. While others lose strength in the pursuit of prey, the vulture waits patiently – it only spreads its wings when it smells blood on the air.

You will be my vulture, V. I heard a Tyger Claws casino has been robbed by one of their own – a dealer. The girl had an alias, Vortex, and she managed the casino's machines. She programmed them to skim a small percentage so a drop from each win landed in her bucket. It took years for the Tygers to realize how they were being cheated. You can imagine they were not pleased. But their ferocity extended too far. Vortex died during the interrogation before revealing where she stored the stolen money. A vulture is wiser than a Tyger, V. You will find it.

I will send you the Vortex's last known location. Don't let me down.
Wakako Okada: I have received information that Vortex's shard is on its way. You did not disappoint, V. That deserves compensation. I am closing the contract and transferring your fee.
Wakako Okada: Have you ever been to a zoo, V? Do you know what happens if you provoke a tiger before opening its cage? No? This will be your chance to find out firsthand. The Tygers have your scent. Will you hide? Or will you fight?

title: Present for the Tyger Claws
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: Special Delivery
Objective: Meet with Sergei Karasinsky and deliver his gift to the designated address
Location: Garage on Redwood St.
Details:

Sergei Karasinsky called. He's a solo who, like my husband, acts before he thinks. It's a personal characteristic that always leads to the same thing sooner or later – trouble. Fortunately for us, Sergei is not only a man who acts without thinking but a panicked one at that. This means the pay is good and almost literally flying out of his account into ours.

Sergei is waiting for you at Silk Road. You will meet him there and pick up the peace offering he would like delivered to the Tyger Claws. He can't do this himself because he's recently been added to their blacklist.

The boy believes this small token will help the Tygers find forgiveness in their hearts for his terrible mistake.
Wakako Okada: I see you do not ask unnecessary questions, V. You simply do what is asked of you. I admire such an approach, and I know how to compensate it. Contract closed.
Wakako Okada: You would be the last person to get bought by a corpo stuffed in a trunk. Or so I thought. You never fail to surprise, V. Though I do suppose he who offers most shall get his way. Oh, I do not mean Sergei. No, sadly he was outbid by another interested party. Who knows what will become of him now... Quid pro quo, V. Quid pro quo. Contract closed.
Wakako Okada: My dear V, you have disappointed me. What use is there in that? Next time, think before you act – otherwise you gamble with my temper. It is a losing game. Talk soon, V.

title: Who is in Walter O's head?
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Protect Walter Ozark
Location: Japantown
Details:

V, urgent job for you. A client just called about a problem with his head. Someone is in it.

Client's name is Walter Ozark, a corpo – didn't say where but it's an urgent request with good pay so I didn't ask. Like any mid-level manager, he was issued a memory backup implant. But Walter believes he has reason to suspect that it was laced with malware. In other words – he has someone listening in on his thoughts. Probably a rival colleague but – again – who cares.

Walter plans to reboot his implant but says as soon as tampering begins, the person responsible will receive a signal. If so, they could send someone to intervene. Walter's decided the safest strategy is to carry out the operation in a moving car to buy more time. I already have a runner willing to burn out the malware, but I need you behind the wheel. And remember – there's a reason why I hired you for this rather than a normal chauffeur. I'll send you the coordinates.

title: 8ug8ear
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue netrunner from Tyger Claws
Target info: 8ug8ear, real name unknown, 24 years old
Location: Salinas St.
Details:

Used to be 8ug8ear and the Tygers got along. They were supposed to work a Kiroshi warehouse job together, but she left them out to dry – remotely drove out a van packed with high-end gear and abandoned them inside. Certain death. But those Tygers are a tough crew, you know how stubborn they can be. The next day they pull up to her apartment wanting to know where she stashed the tech. 8ug8ear was desperate, escaped to the Net, shrouded herself in soft that'd flatline her if they tried to disconnect her. Of course now they just have to watch the clock tick. Eventually, 8ug8ear will have to come out or risk frying her own synapses. And the Tygers are patient, especially in matters of revenge. Personally, I think they like it more this way.

Get 8ug8ear out of there and give word – I'll send transport. But remember to disconnect her safely. She's useless to me dead.
Wakako Okada: Your transport is waiting outside.
Wakako Okada: Well done, my dear. I am pleased. As they say, we will be in touch. Contract closed.

title: Mr. Gutierrez's dilemma
text:
Wakako Okada: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal the shard with Emilio Gutierrez's depository receipts
Location: Apartment on Palm St.
Details:

Would you like to hear about my fourth husband? He was very lazy, gullible, and filthy rich. I divorced him as quickly as I could and never made so much money in such a short time. With that said, can I really blame Mrs. Gutierrez for stripping Mr. Gutierrez down to the last enny? Of course not. In fact, I'd like to meet her lawyers.

But enough about Mrs. Gutierrez. Our client happens to be the injured party, Mr. Gutierrez. He lost his car and luxury penthouse, now the poor fool has barely anything to live in because he left his depository receipts in their old apartment (the locks are already changed). You'll have to retrieve them, because our new divorcee isn't going to give them back out of the kindness of her heart.

The penthouse is on the last floor of the building. Don't worry, I'm providing you with elevator access.

For obvious reasons, Mr. Gutierrez is counting on your utmost discretion. If things go quietly, he'll toss in extra.
Wakako Okada: Perhaps you are not aware, but raising the alarm and discretion are not the same thing. Keep that in mind for the future. I am closing the contract.
Wakako Okada: Discreet and with finesse – something I cannot say about Mr. Gutierrez's divorce. Marvellous work, V. Closing the contract.

text:

Wakako Okada: Well done, my dear, I see that you treat your work seriously. Not only have you earned my respect, but those of more serious clients. I leave the best contracts in your capable hands. Treat them with respect.
Wakako Okada: I am not happy. That does not bode well... for you.
Wakako Okada: I do not accept failure. You would be wise to remember that.
Wakako Okada: My dear, you are becoming more popular by the minute. Your actions have turned even ordinary people's heads. I suppose vendors may treat you differently from now on... do not be surprised to see discounts.

title: Cars for sale
text:
Wakako Okada: V. In your line of work, one must be quick and punctual. Since you seem to struggle with both, I figured you could use a motorcycle. If you can have only one, let it be the best – the Yaiba Kusanagi. I happen to have one for sale. Buy it and you will not regret it.
Wakako Okada: Yo, got a Quadra 66 up for sale. Previous owner was a SoCal and 6th Street-4eva type who liked to slam the gas racing the streets at night... till he slammed right into a corpo. Yeeaaah, can't say that ended well for him. But don't worry, the fender and windshield are brand new and the ride's in preem shape - all it needs is a new owner ;)
Wakako Okada: Hello, V. I have an Arch Nazaré's that is looking for a new owner – practically new. It onced belonged to a corpo who wanted to impress his minions... except he did not have the first clue about handling it. He braked a little too hard and launched himself into the air – skull smacked the pavement so forcefully that not even TT Platinum could save him. Thank God for idiots. So, are you ready to buy?
Wakako Okada: Yo yo, V. Got some eddies to burn? Maybe, I dunno, you'd consider buying a Caliburn? You heard right – A FUCKING CALIBURN! Beautiful machine, a downright work of art. If I could, I'd make love to this thing. Used to belong to Cytech's CEO, but the gonk sold it cuz apparently, and I quote, "Only poor people drive two-year old cars." Shit, I wish everyone could be poor by that definition. I just hope this Caliburn gets a loving owner, cuz she deserves it. If you're interested, lemme know.
Wakako Okada: Listen, V. I have a Cortes for sale. It once belonged to some trust-fund kid who got it for his birthday, except instead of driving it around he preferred to stay hooked up to porn BDs all day. Eventually the family disowned him, sold his car, and now here we are. So, you interested? Take a look and give me your answer soon.
Wakako Okada: "As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared." I have a theory that cars would please the Lord if He returned to our world – in particular, the tuned up Chevillon Thrax 388 Jefferson I have for sale. A car so mighty and majestic it almost makes you want to bow down to it. A great car destined for a great person. The question is, my dear V, are you worthy of it? Do some soul searching, check your balance and get back to me.
Wakako Okada: I have a Quadra Turbo for sale, parked at the attached coordinates. I suspect it will not stay available for long, since it is a good machine and there is no shortage of buyers. If life has taught me anything, it is to seize an opportunity as soon as it appears, for it might only appear once. You can think about that while you gather the money to pay.
Wakako Okada: Transfer well received. Note that I do not take refunds.
Wakako Okada: A new addition. Finally. May it serve you well.
Wakako Okada: Hello, V. I have a Makigai MaiMai for sale. Aside from sounding like a fruity cocktail, it is a little small – but you, your guns and your groceries will fit right in. What more do you need?
Wakako Okada: V! I have a great deal for you – a Rayfield Aerondight "Guinevere"! It belonged to the ambassador of Argentina... that is, until the country returned to martial law and the only thing waiting for him there was a noose, so he sold everything he could and fled the city. He didn't try to bargain with me – the sign of a smart man. I too would be smart if I were you and get your cash ready, because this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The world ain't exactly teeming with these beauties. Everyone wants to be unique, stand out, be noticed – I know you do too. The Aerondight can make that happen.

title: Hunt for the white raven
text:
Rogue Amendiares: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Rare, bootleg Samurai recording
Location: Parking lot on Crockett St.
Details:

There's this old saying – if it wasn't for fools, there would be no sages. The same is true for fixers.

The fool who needs your help is a man named Dan. Dan has a gambling problem – lately he managed to lose his car in a game of cards. To tell the truth, the ride's no great loss or anything – this guy isn't short on cars. What was valuable, however, was the one-of-a-kind bootleg Samurai recording stowed in the trunk. How did our fool come into possession of it, you ask? Well, he's Nancy's son. The same Nancy who played keyboard for the band, in the days when that snot-nosed boy used to call me "aunty."

You'll get that album for me. Gut tells me they haven't pawned it off just yet, it's probably still stashed somewhere around the place. And if you can swing it, grab Dan's car too for a little bonus. I'll snap you the coordinates of the guy holding the goods. And be aware, he licks the boots of the 6th Street Gang, so expect to deal with another fool. A stubborn one.
Rogue Amendiares: One last thing. There is a bonus reward waiting for you at the nearest drop point.
Rogue Amendiares: A gig well done, V. Our client's satisfied not only to get his hands on that recording, but the wheels too. A satisfied client means a satisfied fixer. Hell, you should be satisfied too. Contract's closed and payment's on its way.

Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Rare, bootleg Samurai recording
Location: Parking lot on Crockett St.
Details:

There's this old saying – if it wasn't for fools, there would be no sages. The same is true for fixers.

The fool who needs your help is a man named Dan. Dan has a gambling problem – lately he managed to lose his car in a game of cards. To tell the truth, the ride's no great loss or anything – this guy isn't short on cars. What was valuable, however, was the one-of-a-kind bootleg Samurai recording stowed in the trunk. How did our fool come into possession of it, you ask? Well, he's Nancy's son. The same Nancy who played keyboard for the band, in the days when that snot-nosed boy used to call me "aunty."

You'll get that album for me. Gut tells me they haven't pawned it off just yet, it's probably still stashed somewhere around the place. And if you can swing it, grab Dan's car too for a little bonus. I'll snap you the coordinates of the guy holding the goods. And be aware, he licks the boots of the 6th Street Gang, so expect to deal with another fool. A stubborn one.

title: Upsetting the balance
text:
Rogue Amendiares: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Objective: Neutralize Rebeca Price
Location: Data Inc. Store in Heywood
Details:

I'm guessing you don't follow the stock market, but recently Militech has been lagging behind everyone else. Just stroll around Corpo Plaza and you'll see their HQ abuzz like a hornet's nest. You can tell they're just itching for an excuse to send the armed cavalry into the city.

You've got reasonable people telling you not to get under corps' skins, and then you have Rebeca Price, who decides to open a fucking store selling hacked (and previously stolen) Militech equipment. It's not that I don't value small businesses – on the contrary! It's just that not having the fucking army on our streets is something I value more.

Rebeca Price needs to disappear. The "how" is your call. I won't go into the fine details. And I'm sure you know what to do if any Animals get in your way. They of all creatures should understand the importance of balance in our delicate little ecosystem.
Rogue Amendiares: Package received. Thank you, V. Keep up the good work. The streets will remember your name.
Rogue Amendiares: Excellent. Sometimes equilibrium demands sacrifices. Contract closed.

title: The Fall of Karl Ginsky
text:
Rogue Amendiares: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Retrieve Kang Tao shard stolen from Karl Ginsky
Location: Hargreaves St.
Details:

This is all I know – some guy named Karl Ginsky started with a merlot in City Center and ended with jello shots at a dive in Santo Domingo. Classic case. Everyone's gotta get fucked up time to time, know what I'm saying? As long as you do it smart. Problem is, Karl's brain had more than a 0.23 BAC – it also had a shard. And on that shard lies corporate data. The top-secret kind. The kind you don't talk about.

So, a rusted-gut plastered suit stumbling through Santo Domingo with some platinum-plated shard – what could go wrong? They jumped on him so fast that the only thing he saw were 6th Street patches. If it weren't for the deus ex machina that is Trauma Team, he'd probably be missing more than just his shard.

Head over to where those 6ers are holed up and recover Ginsky's property. If the Kang Tao top brass finds out, even Trauma Team won't be able to save him.
Rogue Amendiares: Things kinda took a shitty turn at the end there, huh? S'OK, shake it off this time. Can't predict the future, right? Happens to the best. Contract closed.
Rogue Amendiares: V, gotta admit – I'm impressed. Things got dicey at the end there, coulda gone tits up in a hurry. But hey, client's still breathing and so are you. I'll arrange a safehouse for Karl to sit tight in. Guessing he'll gladly front the extra bill. Slick work, really.
Rogue Amendiares: Oh, and be sure to contact Karl when you get the shard. You should give it straight to him.
Rogue Amendiares: Fuck, V! 6th Street are calling in reinforcements. Grab the shard and delta outta here!

title: Pro publico bono
text:
Rogue Amendiares: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Objective: Vic Vega
Location: Carsten St, Rancho Coronado
Details:

At first I thought it was just rumors and the kind of drunken bullshit you hear at a bar at 3 AM, y'know? But when you hear the same story from three separate witnesses, you start taking an interest. Now that my informant confirmed the accounts, it's time to dive into the action.

Look, I don't wanna sound like some naggy old crone, but back in my day workers knew how to stand up for themselves. Instead of fixers they had unions to fight for their rights. I know, I know. Anyway, now with the unions gone, these workers can't afford to hire fixers on starvation-level salaries. Lucky for them, I like to do some pro bono work from time to time. You know, a little something for the public good.

Onto the fine detes. Vic Vega – the kind of scum who writes "cracking skulls" in the hobby section of his CV. Well, that's exactly what he's doing in Rancho Coronado. Cracking skulls. Not only that, but he's got the full backing of the corp execs, who'd rather give their workers brain damage instead of a 2% raise.

Vega and his people've been terrorizing the whole neighborhood. Workers've had enough – who the fuck wouldn't agree? You're gonna find Vic Vega and end that psycho for good. Maybe then the corpos'll realize they crossed the line.
Rogue Amendiares: Vega's takin' a little nap in the trunk, no civs hit – yeah, knew you were the right one for the job. Very soon Vega will learn his actions bear consequences. I'll teach him that personally. Pro bono. Nice work, V. All Night City thanks you. Gig closed and sealed.
Rogue Amendiares: Was I speaking in tongues, V? I said no blood, not among civs. They've suffered enough. Although the end can justify the means, sometimes. Let's hope that's the case here. Contract closed.
Rogue Amendiares: What the hell happened? I already sent the car! Do the words "for the public good" mean anything to you, V? 'Cause what you pulled back there – that shit was the opposite of good. Those people have suffered enough. Christ… But at least Vega's fuckin' dead. Gig closed.
Rogue Amendiares: Hey, I already sent the car. You were just supposed to knock Vega out, toss him in the trunk. I know the scopsucker deserved to die, but… well, at least there wasn't any collateral damage. Community's suffered enough as it is. Gig closed.
Rogue Amendiares: Do the words "for the public good" mean anything to you, V? 'Cause what you pulled back there – that shit was the opposite of good. Those people have suffered enough. Christ… But at least Vega's fuckin' dead. Gig closed.
Rogue Amendiares: Vega's flatlined and no one else is, so I'll chalk that up as a "win." Community's suffered enough as it is. Gig closed.

title: Jake's masterpiece
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Upload a virus and retrieve Jake Estevez's custom car
Location: McBride St.
Details:

Why is it some unwritten law of the world that every talented techie has shit-poor character? Only God knows.

Jake Estevez is one such genius among techies and an asshole among shitheads. Fifteen minutes with the man and my barrel against his forehead, but good news is we found a way to get along.

Jake's been a grease monkey for 6th Street about TWO WEEKS now. (Of course, I'm not on good terms with 6SG, but I do grudgingly admire their patience. It is, after all, a virtue.) Over that time Jake's been doing a custom job on a car for them – his "life's work," he says. Designed the soft for it too. Remember I said he has shit-poor character? Yeah, well he pissed off the wrong pendejos in 6SG and had to delta and never look back.

Bottom line: Jake wants his precious car back. Go the 6SG autoshop, upload the virus I sent you and get it back for him – don't scratch the ride and you'll get extra. We'll both be flush after this.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Excellent. The car has reached its owner – now the money will reach you. Good deeds are always repaid in kind. Closing the contract. Until next time.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: V, I trusted you, and you failed me. I believe we both stand to learn from this. Go with God.

title: To dust thy shall return...
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Shard with daemon program
Location: La Catrina Crematorium, intersection of Phalarope and Plover St.
Details:

I'd like you to commit a minor transgression against God and His people – disturbing the dead from their eternal rest.

Deceased's name is Jim Greyer. He smuggled unstable shards by slotting them inside his head. Sadly, during his last transit things went sideways. The Daemon got out of its cage and barbecued his brain. Jim Greyer ended up in the La Catrina funeral home along with my client's shard.

Go to La Catrina, find Greyer's body and get that shard before it's burnt to cinders. FYI – the crematorium's cozy with the Valentinos. That's where they get rid of their bodies. One wrong move and you'll end up there too.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: You're an angel sent from heaven, V. The daemon-possessed shard's on its way to the client, just like your money's on its way to you. Closing the contract.

title: Sinner
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Target: Tucker Albach
Location: Condo on the corner of Scoffield and Sinkyone St.
Details:

A girl died a while back in the Glen. Her name was Rosita. I knew her. Seventeen years old, picture-perfect smile. Got hit by a car while she was crossing the road. I saw the CCTV – almost tore her legs off clean. If she'd've gotten to the emergency room sooner, she might've lived. Who knows. But it was the middle of the night, empty street. Driver fled the scene.

Soon enough, the NCPD found our culprit. Lady's named Tucker Albach, vice managing director or something at Kiroshi. Her insurance covered vehicular manslaughter so as far as the NCPD's concerned – she's off the hook. Only punishment she got is her insurance raising her premium. Hardly a slap on the wrist.

Over my dead body. This isn't what justice is supposed to look like. Eye for an eye, tooth for a tooth, hand for a hand, wound for a wound. Rosita wants Tucker gone, and you're gonna pull the trigger.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Due to arrive shortly.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: You don't want to get your hands dirty, sully your conscience? I understand, V. I will make sure Tucker Albach is judged. Fairly. Contract closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: It is not up to you, V, to decide a sinner's fate. We'll have to tell the client that Tucker disappeared. Then we can only hope she never returns to the city. Contract closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: So, don't want to dirty your hands, trouble your conscience? Understood, V. Tucker Albach will have her Judgement Day yet. I'll see to it. Contract closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: And the spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and slew thirty men... plus Tucker Albach. Well played, V. Bloody but efficient. Closing the contract.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: In trust and secrecy lies our strength. Trust and secrecy. And here you simply show up at Tucker's, then leave? For what? For her to patiently await your return, hm? No. Now Tucker knows she's being hunted. No more secrecy… no more trust. Next time, realize your actions carry consequences.

title: Eurodyne's guitar
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Thievery
Target: Kerry Eurodyne's guitar
Location: Apartment building on Lobos St, 17th floor, apt. 1702.
Details:

There was this band in the 20's, Samurai, maybe you've heard of them – talentless bunch of angsty, skezzed out kids who thought they were actually making music. For some reason, people nowadays still listen to them. One more reason why this world's going to shit and the end times are near.

I'll cut to the chase – my client wants to get his hands on Kerry Eurodyne's guitar, one of the members of Samurai. Weird gig, I know, but the eddies are legit, and that's all that matters.

I tracked down the guitar – it's owned by one Gaston Slayton. Guy's obsessed with Samurai and is a collector of the band's memorabilia. Getting into the building shouldn't be a problem – you'll have access to the elevator. Only thing is, Slayton's unit will probably be tightly secured – Eurodyne's guitar is his prized possession. Drop me a line when it's done.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Be careful. Security in the lobby. Go through the basement, my netrunner will get you access to the elevator.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: I can truly count on you, V. The guitar is in the right hands – securely now. Closing this contract and transferring your compensation.

title: For the greater good
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Scandium rods
Location: Megabuilding H1, Congress St.
Details:

This isn't your run-of-the-mill gig. Client this time is me. You know the H1 megabuilding in the Glen? City within a city – crumbling tower of concrete and faulty wiring. That it hasn't already collapsed is thanks to a guy named El Gallo. Brilliant techie, he was. Past tense.

It's the same old story. El Gallo's got a drug problem. A big one. He's completely lost touch with reality, goes from one score of syn-coke to another. Needless to say, he's in no state to repair any creaky doors. But for some reason he got it into his head that everything'll be better if he could just get his hands on some scandium rods, so he stole them from a corpo warehouse.

These rods are rare parts. Rare and very expensive. I wouldn't want to see them go to waste. Go to H1 (access code's already taken care of) and get them from El Gallo before that junkie pawns them. I don't care how you do it, so long as it gets done.

Objective: Scandium rods
Location: Megabuilding H1, Congress St.
Details:

This isn't your run-of-the-mill gig. Client this time is me. You know the H1 megabuilding in the Glen? City within a city – crumbling tower of concrete and faulty wiring. That it hasn't already collapsed is thanks to a guy named El Gallo. Brilliant techie, he was. Past tense.

It's the same old story. El Gallo's got a drug problem. A big one. He's completely lost touch with reality, goes from one score of syn-coke to another. Needless to say, he's in no state to repair any creaky doors. But for some reason he got it into his head that everything'll be better if he could just get his hands on some scandium rods, so he stole them from a corpo warehouse.

title: Nature's balance
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Objective: Neutralize José Luis
Location: Bus Depot on Benko St.
Details:

A few weeks ago a police officer was shot dead. Same old story – some Valentino kids got into a scrap with the badges. The fatal piece of lead was shot by a ganger named José Luis.

The investigation was dropped and officers from the local precinct were told to back off. Pretty interesting turn of events, wouldn't you say? José must have some friends in high places.

Here's the deal – one of the officers wants José to be brought to justice, which is where you come in. If you happen to find out who's protecting the Valentino, I'll throw in extra. Good luck.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Your bonus is ready to collect. I have one more favor to ask. Let's forget this ever happened, hm? Gig closed.

title: Job for the nomads
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Retrieve the Militech car purchased by the nomads
Location: Garage on Russell St.
Details:

A group of nomads decided to run some sidebiz in Night City and bought a stolen Militech SUV from the Valentinos. This happened on my turf, but unfortunately they "forgot" to ask me for help because they didn't want to cut in a fixer. The Valentinos took the eddies, slammed their heads against the pavement and told them to fuck off.

The nomads just want to get what they paid for – the right way this time, through a fixer. Their rep Dakota called me and I promised her I would help. The SUV ended up in a Valentinos garage in Wellsprings. You need to get it back.

Getting back at the Valentinos isn't part of the gig – you let me handle it.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: I pay you to fix problems, not create them. Remember that, V.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: V, the point was to return the car in good condition. Yes, the nomads will handle it, but it would have been nice if it wasn't so beat up. Regardless, I'm closing the contract.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Sublime work, V. I knew I could count on you. The nomads are grateful for your help. Contract closed.

title: Forbidden love
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Target: Gustavo Orta
Location: Building on Petrel St.
Details:

The world is built on certain rules. Rules that don't appear out of nothing – which grew from the blood and mistakes of our predecessors. These rules are meant to protect us, but the young disregard them. They believe they are special, that they are not held to the same rules, that fate is theirs to tempt.

Martha Frakes believed the same and now sleeps in a coma after taking a bullet to the head. The streets tell me this is her punishment for abandoning family. The girl turned from her own father, Nolan Frakes, to side with the enemy – Gustavo Orta.

But what the street says doesn't matter – not to Nolan. He believes Gustavo is solely responsible for what happened to his daughter. Let's fulfill the wish of a father desperate for revenge. He's paying, after all.

Go to Gustavo's apartment. Deal with him. Don't worry about authorization. My netrunner made sure you don't run into any problems.

And FYI – if you hadn't caught on yet – Gustavo is Valentinos, Nolan is 6th Street. Stay sharp.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Those who exact justice do so on behalf of our Lord. You've done well, V. I know this isn't always easy, and that's why I applaud your decision today. Contract closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Another sinner finds himself in the place he belongs. A trunk. Gustavo now suffers the purgatory he deserves. And perhaps has a moment to examine his conscience. Let's hope he finds it before the trunk opens back up. This concluldes our contract.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gustavo Orta is dead. Killed by his own hand. How did you get him to do it? Or, actually, no… Don't tell me. She who reveals her secrets erodes her own trustworthiness and reputation. What's important is the result I asked for is the result I received. Contract closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: You had an opportunity to free Gustavo Orta from sin. But you left him there. This man will now live to avoid the consequences of his actions – that is, until Judgment Day comes. We didn't want to wait that long. Remember – God takes note of your transgressions. As do I.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gustavo Orta is dead. Killed by his own hand. I don't know what you told him, but I see he came to understand the gravity of his sin and sought out the justice he deserved. And you walk away with a clear conscience, no? Contract closed.

title: The stench of sin
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal data from a computer
Location: Dicky Twister, corner of Congress and Pajaro St.
Details:

Saint Augustine once wrote: When one has a healthy sense of smell, he will immediately recognize the stench of sin. Well, even anyone with a sinus infection in this city can smell the fuckfests over at Dicky Twister. This gay strip club is full of chicos with glazed, dead eyes who will do anything you desire for an extra eddie tucked into their thongs.

The stench coming from that place finally wafted into NCPD command. My little rats tell me they plan to kick down the door any day now. That's bad news. The owner of Dicky Twister, a pimp called Sr. Ladrillo, is no gonk – and a fanatic for recordkeeping. He has a computer full of data thanks to spying tech in his VIP rooms. We're talking politicians, suits, crime bosses, celebrities (maybe even the cops themselves)... If the boys in blue get their hands on these recordings, Ladrillo's geniusly built house of cards collapses, leaving the whole district in chaos. And chaos isn't in our best interest at the moment.

Klep those recordings at the Dicky Twister before the cops do. Thankfully, the Lord has blessed us – Ladrillo is currently out of town. But better to make haste, for ignoring divine assistance is a sin in its own right.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Got the files from the Dicky Twister. I rejoice, and so should you, for the contract has been closed and your compensation is on its way. Amen.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Oh dear, Ladrillo has already received a tip that someone was messing with his computer. You may have saved the asses of more than one NCPD officer, just don't count on them saving yours from the Valentinos. My advice? Ride the wind.

title: Reading from the Book of Jeremiah
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Target: Karubo Bairei
Location: Dive bar on the corner of Congress and Pigeon st.
Details:

There's a time for forgiveness and a time for revenge. There's a time for turning the other cheek and a time for crushing your enemies like the roaches they are. In the words of the prophet Jeremiah: "Cursed is he who keeps their sword from bloodshed!"

The man you're to eliminate is Karubo Bairei. He's an old-timer, but don't let appearances fool you – he used to be a solo. He killed my friends – people who were like brothers and sisters to me. When all hell broke loose in Night City, he fled to the east coast. Now he's back, probably thinking everyone forgot about him. But not me.

Karubo runs a filthy dive that serves as a Valentinos hangout. Go there and show him that nobody can avoid the hand of justice.

And try not to make a scene, OK? Be professional – no unnecessary attention.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: "And you will know I am the Lord when I lay My vengeance upon you." Upon greater reflection, I felt you deserved a bonus for the job you did. Find it at the nearest drop point. And go with God.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: "And you will know I am the Lord when I lay My vengeance upon you." And thus Karubo Bairei came to know the Lord's wrath through His humble servant. Excellent work, V. The contract is closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Thanks to you, I'll be the one taking Karubo on his journey from our earthly plane... Closing the gig. Praise be to thee, V.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: I already see Karubo in the fiery jaws of Hell, I hear his piercing screams, I smell the sinner's burning flesh. In other words, my heart is full of joy. Contract closed. Go with God.

title: Javier Alvarado's IOUs
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal data on Javier Alvarado's embezzlement activity
Location: El Pinche Pollo Restaurant
Details:

It's election season so everyone's got a political stick up their ass. Can't say I like it but it is good for biz.

Young woman came up to me, claims to be a media. She must be a wizard with words because I've never seen a mediajock like her burn so much cash.

She's fishing for dirt on the mayor's adviser, Javier Alvarado. Says Alvarado is bezzling public money, padding the Valentinos' pockets.

Proof? Apparently found in the office of El Pinche Pollo, some Valentino-run restaurant. Have a look there. This media seemed confident of her sources.

And you know how this rolls. She fronts the eddies, we don't ask who she "writes" for.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Data received. Thank you.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Flawless, V – all according to plan. Glad I can count on you. Contract closed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: On your toes, V. Word is the Valentinos intend to make you their human piñata.

title: Cars for sale
text:
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Hey, there's a used Columbus parked at the market, waiting on a buyer. Belonged to a choom who used to move drugs around town, so you might hang up an air freshener or someting. I don't mind the exotic smells so much, but each to their own, right? Lemme know what you think.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Yo! You wouldn't happen to be lookin' for a new ride, would ya? Cuz I got a Quadra Turbo-R for sale. Real beaut, belonged to a choom of a mine – a merc like you. But then she retired, liquidated her account and took a one-way trip to Somalia, sipping piña coladas and tanning her bare ass on her own private beach. It's a waste of a fine car if it doesn't find a new owner. Take a look, will ya?
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Greetings, V. I have an Alvarado for sale in excellent condition, sitting in Rancho at the attached coordinates. I acquired it from a Valentino who had so many enemies he barely got out of town alive. Still, he managed to sell me everything he owned, including the car. You can tell it belonged to someone who was vain, glued to his earthly possessions... but I must say, the purr of the engine is like music to the ears. If you want it, just say the word – and make the transfer – and it will be yours.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: I hope this message finds you well and in good graces. I am selling a motorcycle, and not just any kind – a Brennan Apollo. If you wish to be swifter than the thunderous smiting hand of our fickle Lord, go to the indicated coordinates and open your heart and wallet. I should mention that this is a one-time offer – it would be a sin to miss it.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Money received. I will use it for a worthy cause – rest assured you have done a good deed.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: "As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared." I have a theory that cars would please the Lord if He returned to our world – in particular, the tuned up Chevillon Thrax 388 Jefferson I have for sale. A car so mighty and majestic it almost makes you want to bow down to it. A great car destined for a great person. The question is, my dear V, are you worthy of it? Do some soul searching, check your balance and get back to me.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Listen, V. I have a Cortes for sale. It once belonged to some trust-fund kid who got it for his birthday, except instead of driving it around he preferred to stay hooked up to porn BDs all day. Eventually the family disowned him, sold his car, and now here we are. So, you interested? Take a look and give me your answer soon.
Sebastian "Padre" Ibarra: Godspeed, V. May your guardian angel watch over you.

You can tell it belonged to someone who was vain, glued to his earthly possessions... but I must say, the purr of the engine is like music to the ears. If you want it, just say the word – and make the transfer – and it will be yours.

I hope this message finds you well and in good graces. I am selling a motorcycle, and not just any kind – a Brennan Apollo. If you wish to be swifter than the thunderous smiting hand of our fickle Lord, go to the indicated coordinates and open your heart and wallet. I should mention that this is a one-time offer – it would be a sin to miss it.
Money received. I will use it for a worthy cause – rest assured you have done a good deed.

"As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared." I have a theory that cars would please the Lord if He returned to our world – in particular, the tuned up Chevillon Thrax 388 Jefferson I have for sale. A car so mighty and majestic it almost makes you want to bow down to it. A great car destined for a great person. The question is, my dear V, are you worthy of it? Do some soul searching, check your balance and get back to me.

Listen, V. I have a Cortes for sale. It once belonged to some trust-fund kid who got it for his birthday, except instead of driving it around he preferred to stay hooked up to porn BDs all day. Eventually the family disowned him, sold his car, and now here we are. So, you interested? Take a look and give me your answer soon.
Godspeed, V. May your guardian angel watch over you.

text:

Rachel Casich: Like most celebs - nothing new under the sun. That's a load off my mind then - thought they might be undercover badges or con artists. I'll sign them - thanks.

You may be enjoying the warmth of the limelight right now, just know that I have the power to make it BURN

title: Klep from the kleppers
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal the databank with the transport route data from Malorian Ltd.
Location: Warehouse, Offshore St.
Details:

V, big news going around town. A Malorian van was stolen on Sir Francis Drake avenue. Maelstrom claimed responsibility.

It just so happens that one of my informants saw the whole thing, and he was smart enough to tail them using a drone.

Hard part's over – we already know where they've stashed the van. I'd say we got lucky, but the truth is my people know how to get shit done. OK, OK, I'll quit flattering myself.

Go to the chop shop and find a databank in the van that has Malorian's transport route data. The gangers have no idea it's worth more than the all the cargo they're sitting on.
Regina Jones: Thanks for the shard! Sure it'll come in handy. Gig closed.

title: Ripper needs your help
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue Lucy Thackery from Maelstrom captivity
Location: Clean Cut clinic on Longshore North St.
Details:

Blood looks out for blood. Bertie's a leadhead who was gonk enough to join up with Maelstrom. Realized pretty quick the psychogang operates by simple rules – you stay, you die, or you pay.

In comes his sister, Lucy, who chose option number three. Instead of hard scratch, she bought out her bro's freedom with her expertise and services. She put 3 months of cyberware repair on the table. Problem is, five months have already come and gone.

Now in comes you. This gig's on Bertie's dime – guess he had a few extra eddies stuffed in his mattress.
Regina Jones: Driver's waiting. Get Lucy to the car.
Regina Jones: V, how the hell could you leave Lucy there? You realize Maelstrom's gonna hide her good now, right? I doubt we ever find her now, and there's no one to blame but you. I just don't get it… Talk later.
Regina Jones: Hey. Lucy's safe. Preem work. Thanks.

title: Kicking the hornet's nest
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue Max and bring him to me
Location: the old broadcast TV in Northside
Details:

Night City doesn't like people that like to kick the hornet's nest, and Max Jones... well, he kicked a bunch of 'em at the same time. Kicked them so hard, in fact, that someone put a hit out on him. Thing is, personally, I'd rather he stayed alive.

Max Jones is an old friend from my muckraking days. We co-wrote a vidcast about independent farmers who were put out of biz by Biotechnica drones. Those were the days.

Nowadays, Max doesn't even take my calls. He's as stubborn as they come, but now I'm worried he's really lost touch with reality. He probably thinks he can manage perfectly fine on his own, but that's what all young, gonk men think – that they're invincible. Bring him to reason, will ya?

Sending you the coords to his hideout. If I managed to track him down, it's only a matter of time until the others do too.
Regina Jones: Car's waiting for you.
Regina Jones: Thanks again for handling the issue in good faith. I'm tossing in a little extra – you can collect it at the drop point.
Regina Jones: Thanks for the help! Glad you got through to that stubborn mule. Looks like I'm up to bat with him now. Gig closed.
Regina Jones: Obviously, I know Max is safe, but... from his state I can tell there were some complications. Ehhh... guess that was to be expected... Contract shut.
Regina Jones: I know about Max. I know what happened. Been wondering what to say, what words would hurt the most. But you know what? Not worth it. I should've known a merc like you wouldn't be up to the task.
Regina Jones: I know about Max – that you left him there. This was the one real chance to help, but now… you scared him off. To hide somewhere else. Corpos will probably track him down before I can. Guess you can work out what that means…

title: My guy's in trouble
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue Tiny Mike from the Militech raid
Location: Residence building at the corner of Cortes and Kennedy
Details:

Tiny Mike's got himself in a scrape. You help him today, he helps you tomorrow – you know how it works.

I sent Tiny to klep some files from a Militech facility yesterday and clearly it didn't go as planned (mostly). Tiny swiped the data but Militech tracked the hack and has him cornered. You don't like sad endings do you? Let's try to avoid one here.

Tiny's hunkered down in our safehouse – apartment 63 at a residential block in north Kabuki. Militech's got him pinned inside and surrounded. Armored vehicles, heavy-ironed corpsec troops, the whole thing, probably the fucking spanish armada too. Break through their lines and save my man.

And don't worry – this isn't a charity case.
I’m attaching something that will help you recognize him.
Regina Jones: V, driver's parked in front of the building.
Regina Jones: V, I'm glad things worked out, but next time would you mind ESCORTING THE VIP TO THE CAR? Ugh, contract closed. Be in touch...
Regina Jones: Just got word from Tiny M. Thanks for your help – I do like working with pros. Contract closed.

title: Priceless datapad
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal Alois Daquin's laptop
Location: Housing block on Eisenhower St.
Details:

Alois Daquin – the corpo megaprick who cheated me. And not only me. There's a whole city out there that wants to get its hands on this guy. As they say, the fate of a traitor is sealed at the time of his betrayal.

But what interests me beyond my vengeance is Alois' datapad and, well, the data on it. Our traitor picked up and fucked off right outta NC so fast he left his gear in town.

Just 20 min. ago I got a login ping from his comp on an Eisenhower St. localnet.

Head over there and grab his device. Once we get it, we take advantage of this confused mess.
Regina Jones: Preem, V! Exactly the tech I wanted. Thanks, gig closed.

title: Scourge of kabuki
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Target: Blake Croyle
Location: Aoba on O'Malley Place St.
Details:

Racketeering's the name of the game in Kabuki. The badges pretend like they don't see when hustlers like Blake reel in the next victim.

The script's always the same. Act I – a promising money deal. Act II – an unpayable debt. The sucker this time was Roger Wang, store chain owner. Blake's already seized ownership of one of the stores but has bigger plans. Like I said, this kind of debt's unpayable, so Wang got wise and paid us instead. This human shitstain Croyle is about to disappear, so the time to act is now.

And one more thing – Blake's got huscle from the Animals watching his back.
Regina Jones: There was a problem – you got rid of it. I'm happy, the client's even happier. Good work, V. Gig closed.
Regina Jones: Target bagged. Closing the gig.

title: All in
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Jacob Lamb's implant
Location: Kashuu Hanten Bar, Clarendon St.
Details:

Got a call from Jacob Lamb – friend of mine, director, from the good ol' days. Ex-director, I should say. Ever since Bushido X made a loss of a billion, the guy never set foot on a set again.

Jacob makes a living playing cards. One time he tried his luck at an illegal Tyger Claws casino at the back of the Kashuu Hanten eatery. Things weren't looking good, but instead of getting up from the table, he waited until he'd recoup. First went all his money, then his watch, wedding ring... And finally, one of his optics.

Jacob wants his implant back. Sending you the coordinates of the casino where he lost it. AFAIK, the eye's still there. How you get it is your biz, not mine.
Regina Jones: Jacob got his eye back, so I'm closing this gig, but V... we both know that wasn't top-quality work. Maybe try a little harder next time, OK? Gig closed. And thanks.
Regina Jones: Done and dusted. Jacob sends you his heartfelt thanks. Gig closed.

title: Klepped meds
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Search and Recover
Objective: Recovered stolen medicine
Location: Housing block on Columbus St.
Details:

A few years back I scrolled a little feature called "How Affordable is Health?" It turns out not very. My numbers showed only 3 percent of Night Citizens could afford healthcare. A lot has changed since. For the worse. Some people are declaring open war on rippers, breaking into clinics, klepping meds and chems. No surprise there. And no surprise these rippers want to protect what's theirs.

They want you to recover a pack of stolen meds. Thanks to the GPS tracer hidden inside, we know exactly where to look.
Regina Jones: Thanks, V. Wasn't easy, but you handled it like a pro. Job done, contract closed.

title: Hwangbo's marked for death
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Target: Hwangbo
Location: Motel on Martin St.
Details:

You know that classic comedy setup where a gonk gets into serious trouble and only some, like, misanthropic hardass can save him? Well, let that be your guiding plot for today.

The gonk in question is called Hwangbo. He did some small-time work for the Tyger Claws, but instead of keeping his head down and being patient, he took a shortcut and stole from his own gang. Genius, right? Not only that, but the whole thing had his name written all over it.

Hwangbo's marked for death, meaning he has to disappear – the faster, the better. I already found a nomad smuggler, but someone still needs to get him from one end of the city to the other. But if he's spotted out on the street, the Tyger Claws'll know about it. You know what you gotta do, right? So let's get to it. He's holed up somewhere in the motel on Martin.
Regina Jones: Hurry up! Gettin a sig  – two cars packed of Tygers headin straight for the motel!
Regina Jones: Ya messed up, V. Meaning Hwangbo took a hit, and so did my rep. Not cool. Make sure it doesn't happen again. Closing the contract.
Regina Jones: Flawless work, V. Hwangbo thinks your nickname should be the "Mad Lioness" so I guess he's happy. Closing the gig, sending you the cred.

Regina Jones: Hal's dead, V. Tried to make it out on his own, but that poor girl with cyberpsychosis got to him first. That was the fate you left him to when you abandoned him. I won't forget this.

text:

Target: Jotaro Shobo (age 44, Japanese-American)
Location: Ho-Oh club on Allen St.
Details:

Feel like doing everyone a favor and making eddies doing it? Deal with Jotaro Shobo. Twisted motherfucker like no other.

He's a Tyger Claw and a sadistic scumbag who's got a thing for scrolling XBDs. Find this fucker Jotaro and tell him his days in the entertainment biz are done.
Regina Jones: One less shithead in this city. Preem. Thanks V, closin' the gig.
Regina Jones: Jotaro received. The Mox'll gladly take him off my hands, give him a taste of his own meds. Thanks, gig shut.

title: Hostage
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Roh Chi-Won
Location: Tyger Claws dojo on Brookland St.
Details:

Matter's urgent. My client, Macidew Coolidge (you might recognize him from his show,"Boxathon," on N54 from a few years back) is looking for someone to get his coach back from the Tyger Claws.

Here's the deal. Macidew got himself into a debt hole. Looking to climb out the easy way, he cut a deal with the Tygers. They gave him a wad of cash to go down in the next fight. And what did he do with it? He goes to the bookie incognito and bets on his own win. Next thing you know, he KO's his opponent in the second round and blasts off into the sunset in an AV.

It was happily ever after for Macidew, until they kidnapped his coach, Roh Chi-Won. They're threatening to kill him if Macidew doesn't come back to Night City. Macidew doesn't want his coach's death to weigh on his conscience, so he got in touch with me and I got in touch with you. Sending you the coords for where they're keeping Roh Chi-Won. Try getting to him without tripping the alarm. Hostages and shootouts don't mix well. Good luck.
Regina Jones: P.S. I tossed in a little well-deserved bonus at the closest drop point. Enjoy ;)
Regina Jones: Car's waiting.
Regina Jones: Transport's outside.
Regina Jones: Car's already parked and waiting.
Regina Jones: Well, Roh's secure, but I dunno... Guess I was expecting something more? Like more discretion? Next time, try and go that extra mile, 'K? Gig closed.
Regina Jones: Sig reached me that Roh's secured. Can't say I'm not impressed. You handled it like a real pro. Closing the gig, sending the eds.
Regina Jones: V! You hit the Tygers in a weak spot. They'll be lickin that wound for a while, but some of em are already on your tail. Watch your back out there.

text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal Mikhail Akulov's datashard
Location: Hotel Raito on Adams St.
Details:

Some loose-lipped, bar-hopping Arasaka suits have let out word about some big deal going down with the commies. Seems it wasn't just talk for a pissing contest with rival corpos either. THE Mikhail Akulov arrived in Night City a while ago (the one from the car with the tracker). A top-class Soviet fixer.

My client wants Akulov's datashard, supposedly containing extremely valuable intel on talks with the Japanese.

Go the hotel where Akulov's staying and swipe that data out from under his nose. As if it needs to be said but he'll have heavy protection. And remember I'll pay extra if you get in and out without a trace.

Call me when it's done.
Regina Jones: One more thing! Theres an extra bonus in the Drop Point for your excellent work.
Regina Jones: You fucking whacked? Why the fuck did you go back there? Jesus! And everythin was going so smooth! boggles my fuckin mind, seriously...
Regina Jones: Only thing is, you could have done it quietly. Now half the city's gonna know about this mess. Thought we were on the same page. Whatever. Contract closed.
Regina Jones: This sort of gig, no hiccups? Quiet as a roach? Color me impressed. Contract closed, and thanks.
Regina Jones: V, I thought my guidelines were clear. Getting that shard was prio number one! Those people I sent you to? They're pros. Think they're waitin for you to come back? They're gone. You fucked up, V. And it better be the last time. Later.

title: Last honest cop
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Objective: Force Anna Hamill to drop her police investigation
Location: Kabuki market
Details:

Anna Hamill is a blue-blooded cop, through and through. The kind you'd expect to see in some NCPD promo. Beautiful, smart, honest to a fault. In other words, a really bad fit for Night City.

Her NCPD colleagues are another story. They all have back problems from sitting on fat wallets.

This current case Hamill's working has them all breaking out in hives. She's digging into the smuggling racket in Kabuki market, which – if she makes any real headway – means bad biz for her cop buddies' finances. They want someone from outside the precinct to nip this thing in the bud.

Normally that's where I'd leave it, but I wanna add one more thing. I kinda feel bad for the girl. Rather she not flatline if you can avoid it. Convince her to skip town, or drop the case and make a career change at least.
Regina Jones: V, I know you're a netrunner worth your salt, so I'm flicking you this: [FILE]. It's a daemon that'll help you find Anna. Upload it into a subnet near the bazaar and you'll pinpoint where she last logged in.
Regina Jones: V – you sure you know what you're doing? You leave her there, the gig is up. But OK, your choice.
Regina Jones: Real shame about that cop. I thought you'd handle things... differently. Like, I dunno, using words. Ehh... gig closed.
Regina Jones: V of the silver tongue, eh? Glad we got it all worked out. Contract closed.
Regina Jones: V, piece of advice – finish what you start. Not only did you not convince Anna to drop the investigation, you might've done the exact opposite. Stubborn as she is, there's no way this ends well. Follow me? I hope so. 'Cause now her life's on your conscience.

title: Curbing Jae-Hyun's freedom
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Target: Jae-Hyun
Location: Rooftop slums near Allen St.
Details:

Countless dreamers head to big cities in search of a fresh start. And so many of them have nowhere to return to. Outcasts, loners, rejects. Jae-Hyun's put a targets on the backs of those society's failed. And there's no shortage of them in Night City.

Here's the rundown on Jae-Hyun's meat grinder: he identifies some poor bastard, kidnaps them, and delivers them to scavs for biomon or other cyberware removal. They're stripped of their identities and end up the "property" of some shitbag like Jotaro to do with as they please.

Course no one really looks for these people. And even if they did where would they start? What are the odds? To find someone in Night City who doesn't exist?

Let's face it – Jae-Hyun is just one head of the hydra, but fuck it – let's chop it off anyway. Could be a good while before more grow back in his place.
Regina Jones: Jae-Hyun's dead? And here I thought nothing would cheer me up today. Great. Consider the gig closed.
Regina Jones: Another asshole shoved in a trunk, where he belongs. Nicely, nicely done. Closing the gig.

text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Agent Saboteur
Objective: Place GPS tracker on Mikhail Akulov's car
Location: Kabuki port
Details:
When a top Soviet fixer, Mikhail Akulov, landed in NC, it generated a lot of buzz in the biz. So far, says he's just in town to cut a small-time deal. The USSR's premier fixer in town to personally handle minor league gigs at enny stakes? Yeah, can't say I'm convinced either
So what's his game? Why Night City? My client needs answers to these questions and more. They want to follow his every step on NC soil and that's why you need to plant a GPS transmitter on our dear comrade's car. And keep it clean and quiet.
Regina Jones: Quiet and smooth, that's how it's done. Thanks, V! There's a little token of my appreciation waiting for you at the drop point. Check it out when you get a chance ;)
Regina Jones: Sorry, but I don't get it. You were supposed to plant a bug and instead you blow up the fucking car? Pssh, seriously...
Regina Jones: Perfect – silent and effective, just like in the movies. Except we don't make that sorta scratch, but you can't have everything, right? Gig closed.
Regina Jones: This was supposed to be hush-hush, V. No drawing attention... But all right, the bug's planted – that's the most important thing.

title: Tyger infestation
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Target: Taki Kenmochi
Location: Residence building at Cortes and Kennedy St.
Details:

I got a place at this block in Kabuki. Not many know about it (welcome to the club) and I prefer to keep it that way. Problem is a certain Tyger Cunt (and friends) set up a pachinko operation right on my fucking doorstep. Could mean trouble for me down the road.

Lemme guess – you're thinking it's better to hide in plain sight? Yeah, fuck that. When (not if) the NCPD cracks down on those pachinko machines, I know they're gonna poke their ugly pig noses around in my backyard. Can't risk them seeing something they shouldn't.

We can't sit on this. Head to the residential block where a Tyger by name of Taki Kenmochi is running this pachinko show. Deal with her. Any other Tygers in the area will get the message and peace out quick.
Regina Jones: That's what it's all about! One less Tyger in this town. Appreciate your problem-solving skills, V. Gig closed.
Regina Jones: My, what a big rat you brought me! Bit surprised you didn't put her outta her misery. Well, least the vermin's off the street. Gig shut and closed.

title: Van full of syn-leather
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal a Revere Courier Services van
Location: Revere Courier Services warehouse on Martin St
Details:

This isn't gonna be your usual gig. You're gonna go to the Revere Courier Services facility in Northside and steal a minibus full of leather jackets.

Don't worry, I was also scratching my head at first. But the job itself couldn't be simpler.

Someone's smuggling syn-leather combat jackets to NC to get around the corporate embargo. The leather's imported in the form of jackets, which is then distributed to underground ripperdoc that use them for their implants, which are then sold at competitive prices. Quite a supply chain, right? My client tracked down the shipment but can't take care of it on her own. You're her replacement. Just remember that the RCS can't roll until it validates the driver's identity.
Oh and did I mention that the RCS warehouse is controlled by the Tyger Claws? No? Well I'm telling you now. They use it for laundering cash, so don't be surprised to see them prowling around.
Be careful and good luck.
Regina Jones: Fucked it up, V. Forget about the eddies. You're lucky you dont owe me now. Bye.
Regina Jones: Van received. Textbook example of a job well done, don't ya think? A plus plus – contract closed.

title: XBD proof
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Get the raw BD of the murder of Bryce Stone's son
Location: Buildings off Shipyard Way
Details:

My good friend, the televangelist Bryce Stone (don't ask, it's complicated) needs our help. His little boy was kidnapped and brutally murdered a few days later. The NCPD dropped the case due to lack of evidence. Bryce decided to take matters into his own hands and found the BD scroll of his murder, but the virtu's heavily edited, meaning there aren't a lot of clues to go on. If you could get your hands on the raw cut there's a chance we could identify the murderer.

The virtu was put out by two XBD tuners (Gottfrid and Fredrik) in Northside. I'm betting they still have the original somewhere. Just watch out for the Maelstromers that are guarding them.
Regina Jones: V! Get back there and grab the BD! This is our one and only chance!
Regina Jones: Great work, V. Let's hope it helps trace the motherfucker who scrolled the thing. Gig's closed.
Regina Jones: Forget something, V? Like, I dunno, the scroll? No way we track down the original now. You burned our only lead. This was an important contract, one I needed to go well. V, I… These're bad optics. I'm used to working with professionals.

text:

Objective: Steal a recording of Maelstrom's initiation rite
Location: Daniels St.
Details:

Got some paparazzo work for ya. Need to get my hands on a recording of the Maelstrom initiation "ceremony." TLDR to get into the gang you need undergo an optic nerve split operation – a rite of passage, of sorts. Footage of the whole thing, that's what I'm paying for.

Got a tip you can find just such a reel at the HeavenMed clinic – it's the place they put all the new recruits under the knife for the first time. Op rooms are all fitted with cams too. Could be a file, an entire disk, access to the servers – I don't care. What matters is that footage. Get it done.
Regina Jones: Data received, now get outta there.
Regina Jones: Got the data. Thanks, V. Gig closed.

title: Gray area of the law
text:
Regina Jones: Gig type: Thievery
Target: CCTV footage
Location: Maelstrom warehouse on the corner of Industrial and Eisenhower St.
Details:

Client is Aaron McCarlson, NCPD sergeant. Used to work for me as a consultant on the show "Cops 'n' Chops" (8 seasons!!) and is asking for a favor.

Aaron's been digging into Maelstrom for a while now – says he found the warehouse where they torture people. But you know how it is for badges – law slows them down with mountains of paperwork, so if they want to get something done, they have to get creative. Aaron knows that, which is why instead of waiting for fat-assed judges to grant him permission, he wants to get help from a "contractor."

Job's simple. Get into warehouse (coordinates attached), steal the security cam footage and bring it back to Aaron. Should be enough to push his case through. And if you happen to shoot a few Maelstromers along the way, well... shit happens, right? World won't be worse off without them, that's for sure.
V [choice]: Turns out things are a little more complicated than at first glance. McCarlson isn't running an investigation – he's tryna cover up his tracks. Watch the recording.
Regina Jones: Got the recording along with the news that Aaron's dead. Pretty unprofessional, but... fuck it, I might've gone and done the same. The things you see in this fucking city...
Regina Jones: V, I… I understand your decision, but you could've handled that differently. Aaron was a bastard, but a bastard with influence. And you had dirt on him. But what's done is done. Our client's dead and gone which means so's our payment – you understand. Gig shut and forgotten.
Regina Jones: Ugh... Well, this situation took a rough turn. But thanks for a job well done, V. And don't worry about Aaron. Let him sleep it off. When he wakes up, he'll remember we have the recording, and then, well… Then we've got our own inside source at the NCPD. Gig shut and sealed.
Regina Jones: Aaron's happy. I'm happy. Always pays to be on good terms with badges, right? Gig's closed, eddies on their way.
