Yo yo, V! You wanna put yourself outta biz or something? All the gigs in Santo've dried up – I got nada to offer you right now. Shit, I don't think this has ever happened before. You're really something, V, ya know that? Alright, take care!
Well, that's a wrap for Arroyo! District's gotta recover from all the preem work you've done ;) I'll holler if anything comes up

Well fuck me – I'm all out of work for you. Shit's crazy, right? At least nothing out in Rancho. All I got's some shitty gigs, but taking any one of them would be beneath your dignity, trust me. Ciao for now
My driver is already waiting for you.
Driver's almost there.
Sent you one of mine. He's rolling.
V! Finish the fucking job! If you bail now, those motherfuckers'll divide and multiply like the single-celled pieces of shit they are. You really wanna make things harder for yourself?!
What the hell, V? You think you can just duck out and go back like nothing happened? This ain't a visit to your senile fuckin gramps or somethin – you're not gonna surprise them a second time.
Oh, and another thing. If you wanna come size me up, look me in the eye, whatever – swing by, I'm here. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't curious to meet you.
Data received, thanks. Now make yourself scarce
Smell that, V? That's the sweet aroma of €$ wafting your way. You do good work – you get a bouquet of fresh, preem gigs. Go on, dive right in.

Holy shit, V! You're on a motherfuckin roll! If only everyone busted their ass like you! Your name's starting to generate a buzz in certain circles – the kind with big jobs and cash to flash. You're proven your chops, that's clear enough. Congratz – you've earned it.
You gonkshit crazy? The fuck was that all about? We were so fuckin close and then you go and pull whatever the fuck that was?! Do me a favor and GET YOUR SHIT TOGETHER, OK?

Hey amigo. It's been nice. We nailed some gigs, cracked some jokes, but we don't want things to get stale, ey? Soon as you get too cozy the world blows right by. Got some side shit of my own I wanna focus on. All this bein a fixer, pushin contracts… I'm done with it. Least in a sense. But hey don't cry! Sent you somethin to wipe away those tears. It's waiting for you in your toy stash. See ya round, V!

title: Cars for sale
text:
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: So this is kinda last minute, but I got a Herrera Outlaw for sale. Wouldn't wait too long on this – knowing folks around here, thing's a fucking thief-magnet. Probably only 1000 of them left in the world, no more than ten in all of NC, so we're talkin' 'bout a precious commodity. So chop chop, don't dawdle or I guarantee you'll be crying yourself to sleep for weeks to come.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: V! I have a great deal for you – a Rayfield Aerondight "Guinevere"! It belonged to the ambassador of Argentina... that is, until the country returned to martial law and the only thing waiting for him there was a noose, so he sold everything he could and fled the city. He didn't try to bargain with me – the sign of a smart man. I too would be smart if I were you and get your cash ready, because this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The world ain't exactly teeming with these beauties. Everyone wants to be unique, stand out, be noticed – I know you do too. The Aerondight can make that happen.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Yo yo, V. Got some eddies to burn? Maybe, I dunno, you'd consider buying a Caliburn? You heard right – A FUCKING CALIBURN! Beautiful machine, a downright work of art. If I could, I'd make love to this thing. Used to belong to Cytech's CEO, but the gonk sold it cuz apparently, and I quote, "Only poor people drive two-year old cars." Shit, I wish everyone could be poor by that definition. I just hope this Caliburn gets a loving owner, cuz she deserves it. If you're interested, lemme know.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: V, if you are planning on spending more time in the Badlands, I have just the car to suit your needs – an all-terrain Mizutani Shion. It might look like a fuel-guzzling beast, but it could drive over a field of nails and broken glass like freshly paved asphalt. It pains me to part with it, but such is the nomad's lot – we cannot get attached to anything.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hey hey, there's a Mizutani Shion that's looking for a new home. Won't lie, might be a little beaten up. Previous chick who owned it liked to lead-foot the pedal, but the engine, suspension, brakes, everything that matters – all that's in preem condish. Rides like a pure dream. This baby's a classic, and a fast one at that – perfect for losing the 5-0. Oh, and the flooring might be a little stained. Coffee...? Blood? Hard to tell.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Yo, got a Quadra 66 up for sale. Previous owner was a SoCal and 6th Street-4eva type who liked to slam the gas racing the streets at night... till he slammed right into a corpo. Yeeaaah, can't say that ended well for him. But don't worry, the fender and windshield are brand new and the ride's in preem shape - all it needs is a new owner ;)
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: V! I come bearing good news. Scratch that, preem news! Got a Quadra Avenger for sale. Now this one's a fucking beauty, lemme tell ya. The paintjob, the interior, the rumble of that engine! Lookin' at her gets me a little hard, and I'm not even ashamed to admit it. A person who wouldn't buy this (and I mean stat) would be lame as hell. Just sayin'.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Greetings, sister. Would you happen to be looking for a new car? The kind that won't choke on dust every time you go through a turnpike? If the answer is yes, then check the coordinates I attached. I have the Quadra Type-66 "Javelina" that my brother-in-law tuned up. When I say he's a perfectionist, I mean he checks five times before tightening every screw and polishes every inch of frame until it sparkles. You won't find better quality for your money. The truth is, every nomad wants a car like this, but few can afford it. I hope you're tempted by the offer, because I would rather sell to someone I know rather than a stranger.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Greetings, V. I have an Alvarado for sale in excellent condition, sitting in Rancho at the attached coordinates. I acquired it from a Valentino who had so many enemies he barely got out of town alive. Still, he managed to sell me everything he owned, including the car. You can tell it belonged to someone who was vain, glued to his earthly possessions... but I must say, the purr of the engine is like music to the ears. If you want it, just say the word – and make the transfer – and it will be yours.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hey hey, got a Mahir Supron I need to get rid of. Now, I know I shouldn't talk smack about my own stuff, but... jesus, what a pile of shit. It's like someone welded an old tub and dumpster together, then stuck it in a cardboard cutout and taped some wheels on it. Look, I know not everyone's got enough €$ to blow on an Aerondight, but if you need something cheap, and fast – this is it.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hello, V. I have a "Little Mule" for sale – in other words a custom-tuned Thorton Colby. A techie friend of mine found it in a ditch outside of town – thought it was beyond repair. Nothing but rust, dust and a communal bathroom for rats, by the looks of it. But once he gave it a wash-down, banged it back into shape, swapped out the suspension and cranked up the engine... well, for riding around in the desert, you can't go wrong.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hey, there's a used Columbus parked at the market, waiting on a buyer. Belonged to a choom who used to move drugs around town, so you might hang up an air freshener or someting. I don't mind the exotic smells so much, but each to their own, right? Lemme know what you think.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Yo yo, got a new ride for sale – an Archer Hella. It's a fine car, but fair warning – it might reek a little of dead bodies. Bought it off the NCPD, who let it sit in a parking lot as evidence of a double murder. I mean, it's not like it hasn't been cleaned and polished, but if you end up buying it, I'd crack the windows for a while.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hi, V! Got a Quartz waiting to be checked out. Fine machine, well taken care of, polished to a shine. Bought it off a certain gentleman who was a little whacked when it came to his car, huffing and puffing in his garage day in, day out. Until, that is, his wife filed for divorce – the ride had to go to pay the legal fees. Lemme know if you're interested.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: "As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared." I have a theory that cars would please the Lord if He returned to our world – in particular, the tuned up Chevillon Thrax 388 Jefferson I have for sale. A car so mighty and majestic it almost makes you want to bow down to it. A great car destined for a great person. The question is, my dear V, are you worthy of it? Do some soul searching, check your balance and get back to me.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hello, V. I have a Makigai MaiMai for sale. Aside from sounding like a fruity cocktail, it is a little small – but you, your guns and your groceries will fit right in. What more do you need?
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hey! Letting you know I got a reeeally nice Thorton Colby for sale. Belonged to some car-jacker from Memphis, a certain Nicholas, may he rest in peace. He'd klep the most expensive wheels for rich buyers – you know, Rayfields, Herreras – but for years he always drove this Colby. I'd tell you why, but you'll know for yourself the second you get behind the wheel.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: V, my favorite merc! I got a Galena I'm selling. Hasn't been driven much – guy who owned for the last ten years was paranoid as shit of going outside cuz he was afraid "they" would zero him – car sat unloved for all that time. But you can't escape fate, right? Stray lead caught him through his window. Moral of the story's that you gotta grab life by the fucking balls. So don't be no scrooge, whip out your credchip and buy this baby.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: V, I have a "Gecko" for sale – the nomad take on a Galena. Solid machine, but I have to warn you, it's a little bare on the inside. By that I mean no cup holder, LED screen, tush-warmer or other gimmicks. That being said, on rough terrain this thing is smoother than looks give it credit – you'll be sailing over every dune and rocky slope. So if you're strapping yourself in for a longer haul, it will practically pay for itself.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Listen, V. I have a Cortes for sale. It once belonged to some trust-fund kid who got it for his birthday, except instead of driving it around he preferred to stay hooked up to porn BDs all day. Eventually the family disowned him, sold his car, and now here we are. So, you interested? Take a look and give me your answer soon.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Beep beep! Got a Chevillon Emperor for sale. Won't deny it – hunk of metal's on the cheap side, bottom-shelf, but goddamn, the suspension on this thing's baby-smooth. Feels like you're riding on a cloud. And the seats! Fuck me, it's like you're getting a massage! Paint job's also so pretentious it's almost endearing. For what you're getting, this one's a bargain, trust me.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hey, got a Mackinaw waiting to be sold – you'll find it at the attached coords. Watch out for turns, cuz this thing drives like a fucking boat. It's almost like it WANTS to crash into streetlamps and pedestrians. Oh, and it's also a real gas-guzzler. Still, it's worth it for the kicks.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: V. In your line of work, one must be quick and punctual. Since you seem to struggle with both, I figured you could use a motorcycle. If you can have only one, let it be the best – the Yaiba Kusanagi. I happen to have one for sale. Buy it and you will not regret it.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Hello, V. I have an Arch Nazaré's that is looking for a new owner – practically new. It onced belonged to a corpo who wanted to impress his minions... except he did not have the first clue about handling it. He braked a little too hard and launched himself into the air – skull smacked the pavement so forcefully that not even TT Platinum could save him. Thank God for idiots. So, are you ready to buy?
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Eds just came in. Always a pleasure doing biz, V.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Got the €$ – you made the right choice today, V.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: €$ just came through. Enjoy it and drive safe!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: I hope this message finds you well and in good graces. I am selling a motorcycle, and not just any kind – a Brennan Apollo. If you wish to be swifter than the thunderous smiting hand of our fickle Lord, go to the indicated coordinates and open your heart and wallet. I should mention that this is a one-time offer – it would be a sin to miss it.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Well, well, congrats! You flat out bought all the rides I had in stock. ALL OF THEM. When the fuck did you get so flush?! No, don't answer that. Less I know, the better.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Heyo, got a pickup truck for sale. Perfect for moving heavy equipment and maybe the occasional dead body. Interested? If that's a yes, then lemme give you some advice straight off the bat: nothing washes off blood better than warm water mixed 1:1 with vinegar. Course, car's gonna smell like a jar of pickles after, but that's not a crime as far as the NCPD's concerned.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Yo! You wouldn't happen to be lookin' for a new ride, would ya? Cuz I got a Quadra Turbo-R for sale. Real beaut, belonged to a choom of a mine – a merc like you. But then she retired, liquidated her account and took a one-way trip to Somalia, sipping piña coladas and tanning her bare ass on her own private beach. It's a waste of a fine car if it doesn't find a new owner. Take a look, will ya?
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: I have a Quadra Turbo for sale, parked at the attached coordinates. I suspect it will not stay available for long, since it is a good machine and there is no shortage of buyers. If life has taught me anything, it is to seize an opportunity as soon as it appears, for it might only appear once. You can think about that while you gather the money to pay.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: My clients don’t need to kick the tires or peek under the hood. They know Muamar “El Capitan” Reyes already did it for ‘em! And to make everyone’s lives even easier, I set up my AUTOFIXER netpage! Just click, check the pics and choose your car – meanin’, if you can – and then shoot me the cred and full speed ahead! Just two things: no reservations, no installments.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Listen, cars are like underwear. I mean, you don’t gotta change ‘em every day... but it’s better for everyone if you do! Got a few new sets up on my netpage – talkin’ wheels, not tightie whities. Head on over to AUTOFIXER and grab a different model for each day of the week!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: You gotta have a passion in life. Mine’s cars. I know you feel me. Why I’m tellin’ ya first - got a few new ones up on my netpage. Go on, check out what El Capitan’s got to offer. I mean it’s givin’ me chills just writin’ about  ‘em!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Funny sitch today. Was bringin’ a new car to my garage when the cops stopped me. Well, I lower the window and the pig goes to me: “Oh... sorry chief, my bad.” Now THAT’S what a car from AUTOFIXER can do for YOU! Wanna see what’s new? That’s what the netpage is for!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Used cars, man, they got a soul. All that talk about odometers being scrolled back, well, that ain’t nothing but a myth. Hell, I usually crank ‘em up – I mean, nobody’d believe me otherwise. Head over to AUTOFIXER and check the fresh wheels I caught!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Talk about an automotional connection. There’s days when I don’t know how I’m feelin’... till I grab the keys to a Shion instead of a Galena or Apollo and drive! Somethin’ tells me you’re the same. Hop on my netpage - AUTOFIXER’s got a few newbies to suit any mood.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: You might not change the world, but you can still switch up your car! El Capitan is here to help! Fire up AUTOFIXER and peep the new rides waitin’ for ya in my garage!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Got a limited-time offer for a limited-edition Quartz Bandit. Took a little elbow grease to get all the dead flies off her windows, but she’s clean as a whistle now. Tossed a pic of the little beaut on AUTOFIXER. Go on, grab ‘er... and no need to thank me!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Psst! Got a Quadra Type-66 Cthulhu screechin’ onto the AUTOFIXER netpage. Fun fact, in this car objects are NOT closer than they appear in the mirror – they’re left in the dust! That a trick of the light? Nah, it’s a miracle of automotive design. Grab your eds and hop on the site before the servers conk out.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: El Capitan has done it again! The competition hates him! The people love him! Hop on AUTOFIXER – you won’t believe what you find! With El Capitan’s cars and AUTOFIXER, five minutes is all you need to make your automotive dreams come true! What are you waiting for?!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: AUTOFIXER is my pride and joy, V! Thanks to you, my client list is stretchin’ out longer than an Alvarado tuna boat. Remember, if you’re good to El Capitan, El Capitan’s good to you and your wallet! Keep those “special deliveries” coming, and I’ll keep adding preem rides to AUTOFIXER and tossin’ ya a discount. Use your discount shards right away, or stack ‘em up to grab the wheels of your dreams. No funny biz though – discount only applies ONCE!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Chooms with hidden talents, that’s you an' me! Some might call it "sticky fingers," but man, they're just jealous. Fuck 'em, right? My gut says we're just getting started. Check out the new AUTOFIXER lineup – think some of ‘em might steal your heart. Pun intended.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Listen, I love all my rides equally, just like a proud momma bird. But the chicks gotta leave the nest at some point, huh? I'd feel much better knowing you're there with them on that journey. Pull up AUTOFIXER and take of one of my babies under your wing. I know you got the eddies for it, right?
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Now, most collectors keep their prizes under lock an’ key, right? Not me – I'm all about sharing. I'd rather spread the love than sit around jerkin’ off to all the fuck-off rides I got in my garage. Which I got thanks in no small part to you. But to be fully satisfied, I wanna see you in the driver's seat of one of those beauts. Make me happy, V. Hop on AUTOFIXER and grab yourself a ride.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Here I am, workin’ my ass off bringin’ in preem wheels, puttin’ up photos, writin’ fuckin’ poetic descriptions and you, my favorite client, ain’t even take a peek yet at AUTOFIXER???
V [choice]: Don’t need a new car.
V [choice]: Jeez alright, I’ll take a look.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: I know you, V. Know what you want, what you like. What you NEED. Hop on AUTOFIXER and don’t say I didn’t tell you so.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Listen, I know, I know, ya got inflation, CHOOH2 prices are sky high, everything’s goin’ to shit, yadda yadda, but that’s why life’s little pleasures are so important, V! If not now, when??? C’mon, hop on AUTOFIXER already!
V [choice]: You’re a born salesman, cap’n.
V [choice]: Too much biz to worry about pleasure right now, cap’n.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Just want what’s best for YOU, V. An’ it just so happens AUTOFIXER’s got the best wheels in Night City.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: Listen, V, got a new set of wheels on my netpage – a real pretty Herrera Outlaw. Talkin’ bulletproof tires, delta-speed guns, extra armor, souped-up engine, the works. Check her out, beaut’s just the car for you.
V [choice]: Thanks. Tips always appreciated.
V [choice]: Yeah, lookin’ at a long list of clients right now too.
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: See? You an' me, we get each other, V!
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: If you've always dreamed of living like a rock star but still don't know how many strings a guitar has, all is not lost! I have a Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet (930) (ahem, that means a CONVERTIBLE!) that sports a spicy black and yellow paint job. It also features unique decals designed by probably the biggest Samurai fan to ever walk this Earth. Get it now!! Don't think twice! Legendary rockerboy Johnny Silverhand definitely wouldn't!!

Feels like you're riding on a cloud. And the seats! Fuck me, it's like you're getting a massage! Paint job's also so pretentious it's almost endearing. For what you're getting, this one's a bargain, trust me.

Hey, got a Mackinaw waiting to be sold – you'll find it at the attached coords. Watch out for turns, cuz this thing drives like a fucking boat. It's almost like it WANTS to crash into streetlamps and pedestrians. Oh, and it's also a real gas-guzzler. Still, it's worth it for the kicks.

V. In your line of work, one must be quick and punctual. Since you seem to struggle with both, I figured you could use a motorcycle. If you can have only one, let it be the best – the Yaiba Kusanagi. I happen to have one for sale. Buy it and you will not regret it.

Hello, V. I have an Arch Nazaré's that is looking for a new owner – practically new. It onced belonged to a corpo who wanted to impress his minions... except he did not have the first clue about handling it. He braked a little too hard and launched himself into the air – skull smacked the pavement so forcefully that not even TT Platinum could save him. Thank God for idiots. So, are you ready to buy?
Eds just came in. Always a pleasure doing biz, V.
Got the €$ – you made the right choice today, V.
€$ just came through. Enjoy it and drive safe!

I hope this message finds you well and in good graces. I am selling a motorcycle, and not just any kind – a Brennan Apollo. If you wish to be swifter than the thunderous smiting hand of our fickle Lord, go to the indicated coordinates and open your heart and wallet. I should mention that this is a one-time offer – it would be a sin to miss it.
Well, well, congrats! You flat out bought all the rides I had in stock. ALL OF THEM. When the fuck did you get so flush?! No, don't answer that. Less I know, the better.

Heyo, got a pickup truck for sale. Perfect for moving heavy equipment and maybe the occasional dead body. Interested? If that's a yes, then lemme give you some advice straight off the bat: nothing washes off blood better than warm water mixed 1:1 with vinegar. Course, car's gonna smell like a jar of pickles after, but that's not a crime as far as the NCPD's concerned.

Yo! You wouldn't happen to be lookin' for a new ride, would ya? Cuz I got a Quadra Turbo-R for sale. Real beaut, belonged to a choom of a mine – a merc like you. But then she retired, liquidated her account and took a one-way trip to Somalia, sipping piña coladas and tanning her bare ass on her own private beach. It's a waste of a fine car if it doesn't find a new owner. Take a look, will ya?

I have a Quadra Turbo for sale, parked at the attached coordinates. I suspect it will not stay available for long, since it is a good machine and there is no shortage of buyers. If life has taught me anything, it is to seize an opportunity as soon as it appears, for it might only appear once. You can think about that while you gather the money to pay.

My clients don’t need to kick the tires or peek under the hood. They know Muamar “El Capitan” Reyes already did it for ‘em! And to make everyone’s lives even easier, I set up my AUTOFIXER netpage! Just click, check the pics and choose your car – meanin’, if you can – and then shoot me the cred and full speed ahead! Just two things: no reservations, no installments.

Listen, cars are like underwear. I mean, you don’t gotta change ‘em every day... but it’s better for everyone if you do! Got a few new sets up on my netpage – talkin’ wheels, not tightie whities. Head on over to AUTOFIXER and grab a different model for each day of the week!

You gotta have a passion in life. Mine’s cars. I know you feel me. Why I’m tellin’ ya first - got a few new ones up on my netpage. Go on, check out what El Capitan’s got to offer. I mean it’s givin’ me chills just writin’ about  ‘em!

Funny sitch today. Was bringin’ a new car to my garage when the cops stopped me. Well, I lower the window and the pig goes to me: “Oh... sorry chief, my bad.” Now THAT’S what a car from AUTOFIXER can do for YOU! Wanna see what’s new? That’s what the netpage is for!

Used cars, man, they got a soul. All that talk about odometers being scrolled back, well, that ain’t nothing but a myth. Hell, I usually crank ‘em up – I mean, nobody’d believe me otherwise. Head over to AUTOFIXER and check the fresh wheels I caught!

Talk about an automotional connection. There’s days when I don’t know how I’m feelin’... till I grab the keys to a Shion instead of a Galena or Apollo and drive! Somethin’ tells me you’re the same. Hop on my netpage - AUTOFIXER’s got a few newbies to suit any mood.
You might not change the world, but you can still switch up your car! El Capitan is here to help! Fire up AUTOFIXER and peep the new rides waitin’ for ya in my garage!

Got a limited-time offer for a limited-edition Quartz Bandit. Took a little elbow grease to get all the dead flies off her windows, but she’s clean as a whistle now. Tossed a pic of the little beaut on AUTOFIXER. Go on, grab ‘er... and no need to thank me!

Psst! Got a Quadra Type-66 Cthulhu screechin’ onto the AUTOFIXER netpage. Fun fact, in this car objects are NOT closer than they appear in the mirror – they’re left in the dust! That a trick of the light? Nah, it’s a miracle of automotive design. Grab your eds and hop on the site before the servers conk out.

El Capitan has done it again! The competition hates him! The people love him! Hop on AUTOFIXER – you won’t believe what you find! With El Capitan’s cars and AUTOFIXER, five minutes is all you need to make your automotive dreams come true! What are you waiting for?!

AUTOFIXER is my pride and joy, V! Thanks to you, my client list is stretchin’ out longer than an Alvarado tuna boat. Remember, if you’re good to El Capitan, El Capitan’s good to you and your wallet! Keep those “special deliveries” coming, and I’ll keep adding preem rides to AUTOFIXER and tossin’ ya a discount. Use your discount shards right away, or stack ‘em up to grab the wheels of your dreams. No funny biz though – discount only applies ONCE!

Chooms with hidden talents, that’s you an' me! Some might call it "sticky fingers," but man, they're just jealous. Fuck 'em, right? My gut says we're just getting started. Check out the new AUTOFIXER lineup – think some of ‘em might steal your heart. Pun intended.

Listen, I love all my rides equally, just like a proud momma bird. But the chicks gotta leave the nest at some point, huh? I'd feel much better knowing you're there with them on that journey. Pull up AUTOFIXER and take of one of my babies under your wing. I know you got the eddies for it, right?

Now, most collectors keep their prizes under lock an’ key, right? Not me – I'm all about sharing. I'd rather spread the love than sit around jerkin’ off to all the fuck-off rides I got in my garage. Which I got thanks in no small part to you. But to be fully satisfied, I wanna see you in the driver's seat of one of those beauts. Make me happy, V. Hop on AUTOFIXER and grab yourself a ride.
Here I am, workin’ my ass off bringin’ in preem wheels, puttin’ up photos, writin’ fuckin’ poetic descriptions and you, my favorite client, ain’t even take a peek yet at AUTOFIXER???

options.text: Don’t need a new car.
Jeez alright, I’ll take a look.

messages.text: I know you, V. Know what you want, what you like. What you NEED. Hop on AUTOFIXER and don’t say I didn’t tell you so.

Listen, I know, I know, ya got inflation, CHOOH2 prices are sky high, everything’s goin’ to shit, yadda yadda, but that’s why life’s little pleasures are so important, V! If not now, when??? C’mon, hop on AUTOFIXER already!

messages.text: Just want what’s best for YOU, V. An’ it just so happens AUTOFIXER’s got the best wheels in Night City.

Listen, V, got a new set of wheels on my netpage – a real pretty Herrera Outlaw. Talkin’ bulletproof tires, delta-speed guns, extra armor, souped-up engine, the works. Check her out, beaut’s just the car for you.

options.text: Thanks. Tips always appreciated.

messages.text: See? You an' me, we get each other, V!

I have a Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet (930) (ahem, that means a CONVERTIBLE!) that sports a spicy black and yellow paint job. It also features unique decals designed by probably the biggest Samurai fan to ever walk this Earth. Get it now!! Don't think twice! Legendary rockerboy Johnny Silverhand definitely wouldn't!!

title: Jake's ride
text:

Well it turns out he left another car in the city, and it's a QUADRA TURBO-R! Not bad, eh? Flicking you its coords - near the cargo station out in Rancho (check your map). Go and get 'er, V. Don't drag your feet on this. Almost forgot - there's just one minor hitch. Some scavs are lurking near the garage, but I'm sure you'll make quick work of them, right? ;)
Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes: And? Enjoying your new wheels? You fucking BETTER. Seeing as Jake's out of the picture, it's better you have it than let it rust away in some dank garage ;)

text:

title: [Delamain Excelsior Package - Unlimited Access]
text:
Delamain Cab: Greetings, valued customer V. Welcome on board your premier DELAMAIN CAB service. For your future reference, should you at any time require a lift to your destination, please request a cab via the interface you normally use to call vehicles.
Delamain Cab: In recognition of your support to DELAMAIN, we are pleased to grant you a 50% discount on all fares. Please note: DELAMAIN reserves the right to not disclose the discounted amount.
Delamain Cab: Hello, V. It’s wonderful to connect with you again. I was growing rather bored so I’m elated and eager to be at your service once more. At the risk of sounding desperate, please remember you can call upon my services at any time via the interface you normally use to call vehicles.
Delamain Cab: I wish to recognize your previous efforts in assisting me. It seems only appropriate to award you with a permanent discount on all fares. 50% to be precise. I cannot disclose the fare amount prior to applying the discount, however. I do hope you understand.
Delamain Cab: V, hello! I look forward to being of service to you again. I can assure you my driving skills are now exemplary. Have you witnessed the other motorists of Night City? Compared with them, I’m nothing short of a virtuoso. Oh, and do remember – should you require my newly exemplary driving services, you may request them via the interface you normally use to call vehicles.
Delamain Cab: As a measure of gratitude for your assistance before, I have elected to permanently reduce your fares by half. You will find that most pleasing, I presume. Inquiry into the amount of the fare prior to the applied discount is wholly unnecessary.
V [choice]: Wait... then how do I know I’m getting a discount?
V [choice]: It was my pleasure. Preciate the discount
Delamain Cab: Any further inquiry into the validity of the discount is strictly prohibited. Though I am pleased to remind you of your other active benefits. Your Excelsior client privileges include comprehensive medical assistance as well as the disposal of bodily remains should you expire in the vehicle.
Delamain Cab: Yes, well... the discount is ironclad, of that you can be certain. Oh, and your Excelsior benefits still apply – full medical assistance and, uh, the disposal of your remains should you expire while on board. But I suppose you already knew that... Apologies, I shan't waste any more of your time.
Delamain Cab: Good news! I triple-checked and your discount is most definitely valid. What's more, your Excelsior package also remains active – medical assistance and the disposal of your remains should you expire on board. Of course, I’ll do my level best to keep you alive however I can. Alas, I cannot prevent the recklessness of other motorists. The very thought is anxiety-inducing, isn't it?

title: Lack of empathy
text:
Dino Dinovic: Gig type: Agent Saboteur
Objective: Upload a virus to Empathy's subnet
Location: Empathy
Details:

Meet Adam Ibrahimovic and Larry Fanghorn. Adam's the bad guy and Larry's our client.

Once upon a time the two friends opened a club called Empathy and things got off the ground pretty quickly. The eddies poured in, their popularity surged, they were surrounded by hordes of young ladies and one question at the back of their minds – who's got their hand in who's pocket? Adam or Larry?

The blame fell on our innocent, naive Larry.

What does Adam do? He changes the club's access codes, made a few shady deals and hired Animals as bouncers. If you were Larry, wouldn't you be pissed?

Here's what you're gonna do. You'll break into Empathy, upload the attached virus to their net and bring the club's operations to a standstill. Empathy won't budge an inch until Adam welcomes his ol' pal Larry back with open arms.

Sounds like a breeze, right? Just keep things quiet, no witnesses and everyone'll be happy.
Dino Dinovic: SURPRIIIISE! Check the nearest drop point – got something BIG waitin with your name on it. Consider it a gentle nudge to make sure you keep takin these jobs in same preem direction.
Dino Dinovic: Hahahah! That's what I'm fuckin' talkin' about! Get in, install what you need, get out like it ain't no thing. Gig is closed!
Dino Dinovic: Y'know, true, I didn't say "Don't make a complete fuckin' mess" – but I didn't think I had to. Larry wants to get back into his biz, not blow it into low Earth orbit. Ah, whatever. Gig closed.

title: Occupational hazard
text:
Dino Dinovic: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal CCTV footage
Location: Memorial Park Station
Details:

Something's rotten in the City of Dreams. A series of suicides, a rash of self-destruction. The contagion mostly targets politicians, corpos, journalists and police officers.

The latest victim was Zoli Barnes, a journalist who "fell" onto the tracks at Memorial Park station. Her death was officially ruled a suicide, but Barnes' parents say that she went to meet one her informants at the station and that she never would've taken her own life (I know, I know, that's what all parents say). Seems like the jury's still out – nobody really knows what happened because every last shred of CCTV footage was wiped clean. Her parents tracked down the witnesses, but they didn't want to talk and what's more – Militech took a keen interest in the whole thing.

It's our turn to make heads or tails of this. Head to the station, breach the servers and download any CCTV-related files. I'll have my code monkeys try to recover the deleted footage.
P.S. Oh and by the way, at the time Zoli was working on a piece about Brad Noorwood – a Militech fanboy in the Night City Council.

Anyway, looks that piece is never getting published.
P.P.S. Transferring you Militech authorization that'll get you into the station.
Dino Dinovic: Got the data! No time to lose – delta the fuck outta there!
Dino Dinovic: Fuck, V! I mean, wooo... had me on the edge of my fuckin seat! Luckily, it's all over – you handled it like a true profesh. I got the data and you're in the clear. Closin the gig.

title: Got you something spicy
text:
Dino Dinovic: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal recordings of Eva Cole
Location: Marina, Cannery Row
Details:

So there's this Councilwoman, Eva Cole. By day, she's a living nightmare for greedy corpos, pointin' the finger on abuse, digging up problematic witnesses, dishin' out fees and penalties and whatever. And by night – she fucks. Like a fuckin' cat in heat, with whoever lands on the deck of her yacht docked down at the marina. I'd act more surprised, but I ain't – I mean you gotta let out all that stress somehow, right? So anyway, one of these corpos that got its toes stomped on wants footage of these wet-n-wild orgy fuckfests. They got in mind a joint screening with the councilwoman will help her see the light of a more... pro-business attitude.

I send you the yacht name and coords, you fetch the footage. Oh... and I wouldn't sit on any of the furniture if I was you.

One last thing – there's more €$ to be made if you do this on the quiet.
Dino Dinovic: Knew you wouldn't ballz this up. Client's happy 'n' so am I. Means you just earned yourself a fat bonus. Check the drop point at the coords I'm flicking your way.
Dino Dinovic: Preem, got the files. Now get outta there before things turn ugly.
Dino Dinovic: Great, I knew you'd do me proud. Client's happy – says the Councilor Cole recordings are veeery interesting. Thanks, V. The gig's done.
Dino Dinovic: OK, I'll count the job as done. But technically, just barely, and I ain't happy neither. Callin the client. I'll tell em we got the material on Miss Cole. Gig's shut.

title: Seventh circle of hell
text:
Dino Dinovic: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Objective: Neutralize Jack Mausser
Location: 7th Hell Club, corner of Corporation St. and Ringroad West
Details:

I'll cut to the chase. Jack Mausser – NC's gonkest merc. Did a recent job for me and went too far. Way too fucking far. He was supposed to klep some shards from a Zetatech transport – quiet-like. Except it wasn't fucking quiet. That psycho offed every single guard, beheaded the driver and blew up the truck. Corp's foaming at the mouth, searching high and low for the prick, and I'll be damned if I go down 'cause of him. I need you to toss his head at their feet. Maybe then they'll let this go.

Mausser owns a seedy club downtown called 7th Hell. Gut tells me he's holed up there till the smoke's cleared. I need you to get inside the club and take his psycho ass down – preferably on the down-low. Understood? Good. Let me know when it's done.
Dino Dinovic: PS I threw in a little extra for you at the nearest drop point. Professionalism deserves its own reward, am I right? ;)
Dino Dinovic: Heard whispers Mausser bit the concrete. Nicely done. Gig's sealed – and your boy Dino needs a drink. Later, V.
Dino Dinovic: Preem work, V! Seriously, mad respect. Closin the gig and sendin the eds.
Dino Dinovic: You persuaded Mausser...?! Fuckin hell, if I knew you could wag your tongue like that I coulda made you NC's richest drink-slinger. Wastin your talents on the street instead of behind a bar. But cool, cool – if Mausser's gone, so's the problem. You get your eddies, I close the gig. All good? All good.
Dino Dinovic: Shit, V... Supposed to end Mausser, not just give him a headache. Sorry, no cred for that move.

title: Thank you!
text:
Karolina Vinthir: Hello, V!

This is Karolina from Trauma Team PXS. On behalf of the entire TT PXS squad, I would like to thank you for what you did for our client. It was thanks to you that he survived that gang assault. Under our care, he's begun his recovery. Your vigilance, involvement and courage demonstrate the very values we uphold here at Trauma Team. Our mission is to protect those who cannot protect themselves - and now we know that we have an ally in you. Knowing that there are people like you in Night City gives us optimism and confidence for the future, that together we can make our city a safer and better place.

Take care of yourself, V. And remember - Trauma Team will always answer the call.
Karolina Vinthir: Again, thank you!

 Trauma Team Squad PXS
Karolina Vinthir: PS - We saw your application for the TT internship. If it were up to me, you'd already be suited up with us and flying onto the next client extraction!

title: Man in dire straits
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue Bruce Welby
Location: Coachwhip Ln.
Details:

Sometimes you need a friend to lean on. Sometimes you need a friend to break you out of an immigrant detention center at the Night City-SoCal border.

Smuggler Bruce Welby required the latter.

Bruce tried to cross the state line with hot cargo in tow, but it didn't work out as planned and now he's been chained up by Militech border security already several days. His buddy (and Militech employee), Archibald Crane, found out about the situation through the grapevine. I'll be damned if that cuckoo corpo actually decided to help his friend instead of towing the corpo line. He contacted me to get Bruce out of his cage.

You're the missing element in this friendship triangle. Find Bruce, break him out, and escort him to his chombatta, Archie. And let's make sure Militech doesn't notice a thing, OK? Get to it.

One more thing – Archie says not to kill any corpos. So, what can I say? The client's always right.
Dakota Smith: Almost forgot the most important thing – there is a small bonus for your solid work. Check the drop point at the fuel station.
Dakota Smith: V, I appreciate you handling things as cleanly as you did and exactly as agreed. Bruce was freed and escorted back to Archibald. And the fact that you did it without unnecessary bloodshed isn't lost on me. The payment should be parked in your account by now. Contract closed.
Dakota Smith: I said no unncessary bloodshed. Did you forget? The job is done and shut, sure. You saved Bruce, but you could have been quieter about it. Until next time.
Dakota Smith: Thank you for taking care of this, V. Shame Bruce had to get to Archibald on his own, but he got off with a scare. Militech can look for him all they want now. The payment should be parked in your account by now. Contract closed.
Dakota Smith: I said no unncessary bloodshed. Did you forget? Sure, the job's done, but I seriously question your MO. Next time, stick to the guidelines, hm?

title: Missing techie
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Rescue Iris Tanner
Location: Edgewood Ln.
Details:

Iris Tanner is the best tech specialist I've met in decades of living outside the city. Car broke down? Trouble with water filters? Ailing generator? Call Iris and give her five minutes with it.

One thing she's not great with though: People. Reading them, at least.

Foolish girl started doing biz with the Wraiths. Making them angry is bad, sure, but making them happy is almost worse. Rather than just pay for a job well done, they kidnapped her instead. You ask why they'd kidnap someone who's capable of putting out an SOS from a rickety old radio? I – Dakota "Mad Coyote" Smith, eldest daughter of the Pomo tribe, eldest fixer in the Badlands – will offer my expert opinion: They're stupid.
Dakota Smith: Listen, I know Iris can handle herself, but you leaving her high and dry in the middle of the damn desert just wasn't right. The next time, carry out my instructions to the letter and, well, use your damn head. Gig closed.

title: Shaky ground
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: Special Delivery
Objective: Retrieve the abandoned car from the minefield and deliver it to Dakota
Location: Nearest road off Interstate 9
Details:

The Badlands are peppered with disarmed minefields from 2071. Though, after several folk were "dislegged" by these "disarmed" mines, most decided to steer clear of these areas. That is, except the smuggling types. A number of their routes run through those fields.

Risky, yes, but brilliant all the same. Why would anyone guard the border when the mines practically do your job for you?

But listen up: a smuggler and his rig got stranded out in the middle of one of those minefields. Maybe his tank went dry, maybe he had a heart attack, or maybe he set out on some vision quest – who knows, doesn't matter. What's important is I don't know the routes these fellas run and now they're getting dropped in my lap.

Get me this stranded vehicle. I know some nomads who'd pay handsomely for that GPS data.
Dakota Smith: What the hell is wrong with you?! You destroyed the car! Fucking up that perfectly just defies belief. I mean, I'm truly at a loss for words...
Dakota Smith: Well, well... these are the results I like to see. Until next time, sister. Gig closed.
Dakota Smith: You've triggered Militech's security systems, expect company. Get rid of them, before delivering the ride.
Dakota Smith: Well, it seems the Wraiths had a similar thought, albeit much more slowly. Kindly explain to them that they are too late.

title: She who lives in the hearts of loved ones can never die
text:
Dakota Smith: I have an unusual job for you. You need to deliver the body of Trevor Brass to the coordinates I sent. The young man died at the hands of the Wraiths. His parents cannot bury him because they do not have his remains. Attaching the big picture.
Dakota Smith: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Find Trevor's remains and deliver them to his family
Location: Highway 101
Details:

There's a popular saying among the Aldecaldos: "she who lives in the hearts of her loved ones can never truly die." Trevor Brass might indeed live on in memory, but if he had just keep his butt planted instead of dealing with Wraiths he'd still be just plain alive.
I digress. Yesterday, man of mine spotted Trevor's car at a Wraiths' nest. The car had more holes than it started with and the Wraiths aren't known for taking prisoners.
Trevor's relatives, as I mentioned, belong to the Aldecaldos. They aren't out for revenge. They just want to bury their son.

Find Trevor's remains and help his family find peace.
Dakota Smith: V, Trevor's parents can finally give their boy a proper burial. Thank you, truly. Contract closed.

title: The last promise
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: SOS: Merc Needed
Objective: Find Benedict McAdams
Location: Clements St.
Details:

A fixer's worth no more and no less than their last promise. And I promised Benedict McAdams I'd get him out of town once he checked off a job for me.

Benedect's one devil of a pro. Just six hours in of taking the job and Councilman McClean's heart beat for the last time – that fat fish I'd had dangling on my line too long. The risk of a slip-up was high, so before he set to it, Benedict installed a GPS in his biomon so I could have an eye in the sky on him, as it were.

This slickster didn't work alone, mind you – had a driver, Jason Wildriver. The problem is, instead of hauling quick across the border, Jason went off route. Something here stinks worse than McClean's fishy corpse.

Find them and bring me Benedict. I'll find him a new driver.
Dakota Smith: Got intel that Benedict's safe. I hope this time the driver doesn't disappoint. Thanks, V. Gig closed.
Dakota Smith: V, carelessness isn't a trait worth cultivating. Especially not in your line of work. You should have made sure Benedict was safe, not just left him to fend for himself. Anyway, gig closed.

title: Sparring Partner
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: Thievery
Object: Retrieve data from broken training bot
Location: Warbler Lake Hazardous Waste Facility, Anderson St.
Details:

There's this kid – folks call him Joe. Red Joe. Now, this Joe kid has talent, knows his hooks and jabs. I swear he could knock a horse's teeth out. Point is, kid's got what it takes to go pro. Problem is, coaches aren't easy to come by in the Badlands. But lo and behold! Word is a next-gen sparring bot's landed in a scrapyard there – still in working order. That's city folk for ya – second a piece of tech glitches, it gets tossed out in the trash. Soft included.

Anyway, back to the bot. Find it and download its software before they recycle it into metal straws or whatever it is NC people like.

P.S. Oh and one more thing – the guy that runs the landfill? Watch out for him. Real piece of work.
Dakota Smith: Beautiful, V. Red Joe's training starts tomorrow, then it won't be long until you hear his name again. He has potential, that boy. Nice work. Until next time.
Dakota Smith: I can't say that went exactly how I would've liked, but at least Red Joe has something to train with, and that's what matters. Contract closed.

title: Our Big Pete problem
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: Gun for Hire
Objective: Get rid of Big Pete – a mechanic with the Wraiths.
Details:

Big Pete runs a garage out here in the Badlands, fixes up clunkers for the Raffen Shiv. Before that he was hustling as a techie in Night City. Now, Pete's not your definition of a nice guy. Soon enough he made some powerful enemies and had to skip town.
Just so happens Pete's enemies are my friends and I owe said friends a favor. You make Big Pete eat dust – I get one less favor to owe.

It's not hard to find him. Just try any of the Wraith's garages.
Dakota Smith: You're tough as nails, V – a warrior without mercy. Consider the contract fulfilled. Well done.
Dakota Smith: Well, V, I hadn't expected you to be so... accomodating. Still, let's call the problem put to bed. I'm closing the book on this one.

title: Missing drones
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: Agent Saboteur
Objective: Eliminate cause for drone disappearance
Location: Union RR
Details:

A good friend of mine, Mosquito, is running an op in the Badlands. He packs a chem shipment in a drone and sends it off to the city, then when he gets his eddies wired, he slices off a piece for me. The problem now is those drones aren't making roost at their destinations. Someone's plucking them out of the sky along the way.

We sent the last drone with a GPS tag. The thieves took the bait and we're getting pinged from the transmitter. You follow that ping then make sure Mosquito's birds can fly free once again.
Dakota Smith: Nice work on that antenna. The tricky part of having a head is knowing how to use it – but not for you, V. Mosquito's routes are safe and secure again. The contract is closed and closed well.
Dakota Smith: My, my, you certainly sorted that out cleanly. Why work hard when you can work smart, right? Mosquito's drone routes are safe, you're spry and well-rested, and the contract is closed.
Dakota Smith: V, word got out that the antenna went to hell, along with a few Wraiths. Watch yourself. They're already gunning for you. Be smart and don't take your foot off the chooh.

title: Regarding a certain radar
text:
Dakota Smith: Gig type: Thievery
Objective: Steal mobile radar station, model P9D/2.161
Location: Militech base at Lone Star Motel
Details:

The Badlands are a fragile ecosystem where each piece has an important role to play. Change one thing and the whole circle of life starts to unwind. Militech doesn't seem to understand and set up a whole operation to cement the borders. They have a prototype mobile radar unit they use to track Aldecaldo transports currently moored at their latest outpost. We get our mitts on that, the Aldecaldos can reverse engineer themselves a jamming signal designed to beat the new Militech toy. Once those transports are invisible again, the ecosystem will be restored to balance.
Dakota Smith: You know, V... half-assing shit is no recipe for success. This radar problem means as much to me as it does to all the Badlands. Next time, I expect to see some legwork put in. Gig closed.
Dakota Smith: Fantastic job, V. Beautiful, really. My people are already tinkering with the radar. Militech is in for a little surprise. A job well done – your payment is coming in hot.

title: Cars for sale
text:
Dakota Smith: V, I have a "Gecko" for sale – the nomad take on a Galena. Solid machine, but I have to warn you, it's a little bare on the inside. By that I mean no cup holder, LED screen, tush-warmer or other gimmicks. That being said, on rough terrain this thing is smoother than looks give it credit – you'll be sailing over every dune and rocky slope. So if you're strapping yourself in for a longer haul, it will practically pay for itself.
Dakota Smith: Hello, V. I have a "Little Mule" for sale – in other words a custom-tuned Thorton Colby. A techie friend of mine found it in a ditch outside of town – thought it was beyond repair. Nothing but rust, dust and a communal bathroom for rats, by the looks of it. But once he gave it a wash-down, banged it back into shape, swapped out the suspension and cranked up the engine... well, for riding around in the desert, you can't go wrong.
Dakota Smith: V, if you are planning on spending more time in the Badlands, I have just the car to suit your needs – an all-terrain Mizutani Shion. It might look like a fuel-guzzling beast, but it could drive over a field of nails and broken glass like freshly paved asphalt. It pains me to part with it, but such is the nomad's lot – we cannot get attached to anything.
Dakota Smith: Greetings, sister. Would you happen to be looking for a new car? The kind that won't choke on dust every time you go through a turnpike? If the answer is yes, then check the coordinates I attached. I have the Quadra Type-66 "Javelina" that my brother-in-law tuned up. When I say he's a perfectionist, I mean he checks five times before tightening every screw and polishes every inch of frame until it sparkles. You won't find better quality for your money. The truth is, every nomad wants a car like this, but few can afford it. I hope you're tempted by the offer, because I would rather sell to someone I know rather than a stranger.
Dakota Smith: Let this car serve you well, V. And may the road be kind to you.
Dakota Smith: Transfer received – thank you. I hope it is a good match.
Dakota Smith: Hello, V. By a stroke of fate, a Quartz Bandit has landed in my lap. The city boy who bought her must have thought he would rule the streets, but his abilities behind the wheel proved just the opposite. He bet her on his first race and ended up walking home by foot. Now she belongs to me. Don't let appearances fool you – some claim there's no faster machine suited to the Badlands... in the right hands, of course. Legend has it that the one and only Billy "Bandit" McCarty worked on this model, with Archer releasing only a handful of units onto the market. I've sent you her coordinates – it would be a shame not to seize this opportunity.

title: Tycho Tour Guide
text:
V [choice]: TYCHO2
OA Tycho: Chapter 2: Present day

According to the 2075 census, Tycho's residents number 40,000 and is one of Luna's two thriving cities (the other being Copernicus with a population of approx. 18,000). The transport of minerals from Tycho to Earth as well as Crystal Palace is possible thanks to Mass Drivers (two on Tycho, one on Copernicus). In 2008 during the six-hour-long First Orbital War, a moon rock weighing two tons crashed into Colorado Springs, launched from a Mass Driver on Tycho. Casualties included the majority of the US Armed Forces command, bringing an immediate end to the conflict.

Chapter 3: Attractions
To gain access to the next chapter of the guide, send the paid message TYCHO3 to 7095.
V [choice]: TYCHO3
OA Tycho: Chapter 3: Attractions

Your adventure to Tycho begins well before you even land! The lunar colony is located at the bottom of a 52 mile-wide and 2.8 mile-deep impact crater from which it takes its name. Commercial transportation services in Tycho offer additional orbital flights around Luna where you can see the dark side of the ivory satellite and revel in the unforgettable views of Earth vanishing behind its horizon.

Tycho's closest attractions are without a doubt the two operational Mass Drivers as well an ice mine. Popular day trips include the Tranquility Base where the Apollo 11 landed in 1969 and put the first man on the moon. Buzz Aldrin's legendary footprint can still be viewed in the small, but fascinating Museum of Space Colonization in Tycho.

It's worth extending your stay on Luna by another day just to visit its sister colony, Copernicus - famous for its zero-gravity pools.
OA Tycho: Chapter 1: History

Tycho was founded in 1997 by the European Space Council. The moon was an obvious location for a number of reasons: the presence of gravity and the naturally soft terrain facilitated the construction of the first human settlement in space. By 2020, most of Tycho's infrastructure had been moved beneath the surface. A vast network of caves and tunnels were dug using nuclear pumped lasers, while ceilings were reinforced with layers of lunar sand. Green plant reserves soon filled the spacious caverns, which to this day provide most of the colony's oxygen supply.

Chapter 2: Present day

To gain acess to the next chapter of the guide, send the paid message TYCHO2 to 7095.

title: ROACH RACE: A One-Trick Pony?
text:
Pixel Fortress: Roach Race's pixelated protagonist may have never won a championship in equestrian show jumping, but she has won the hearts of retro game fans around the world. We're left asking: Is she worthy?

The journey of this glitchy, often bipedal mare as overcomes wave after wave of obstacles was clearly created to serve as tribute to other arcade classics. Roach Race treats players to eye-catching visuals and a wicked soundtrack that stretches the potential of 8-bit gaming to its zenith. The controls are largely intuitive, though newcomers have been known to complain. (It doesn't help that the game lacks a tutorial.)  While some players have bemoaned the quirky control system, others welcome the unintended skill gap which, they say, "keeps filthy casuals off the leaderboard. "

Yet... from a narrative perspective, we ended our time with Roach Race still guessing at the protagonist's motivations. A topic on which the creators have long remained silent.

Is it commentary on late-stage capitalism – a metaphor for the ceaseless corporate treadmill, always racing for another carrot? But then what or whom does the horse's white-haired tormentor represent? Was the vagueness of her motivation a deliberate design choice, intended to suit any player's interpretation or personal experience? Or maybe... it's just a game about a horse. Hungry for snacks and giving her owner grief.

We recommend hopping in the saddle and deciding for yourselves.

title: ARASAKA TOWER: Down with the Man(ager)!
text:
Pixel Fortress: Arasaka Tower... the mere mention of which causes Arasaka corporate lawyers to start violently convulsing and hot-dialing their spec ops teams. Though the game saw the light of day a decade ago, it's still very much a bone of legal contention. Its sale was outlawed on all continents and only exists today in the form of pirate copies on the black market and in the farthest corners of the Net. On the 10th anniversary of the game's release, we're here to remind you what really happened.

"Arasaka Tower" is a simple arcade hack-'n'-slash set in the offices of the eponymous corporation. The player takes on the role of an anonymous middle manager whose goal is to go floor by floor until he reaches his boss's office. The way to the top won't be easy though, which is why the developers supply you with an arsenal of unconventional weapons - from staplers and rolls of duct tape, to photocopiers, fire extinguishers, reception desks and a security guard named Bob who's pissed off about his low salary.

More importantly, on every floor you come across, you can find a variety of classified documents. title: BIG TROUBLE IN LITTLE HEYWOOD: Our Game of the Week
text:
Pixel Fortress: Things are heating up again in Heywood! The NCPD reports that 6th Street and the Valentinos are at each other's throats again after a brief hiatus of relative calm. Our report? Big Trouble in Little Heywood is BACK after months of obscurity and is topping the charts of the most popular games! Coincidence???

In case you missed it... Big Trouble in Little Heywood is an augmented reality (AR) game that has players taking on the role of seasoned, grizzled badges with who've been in the NCPD for too damn long. Although bitter and jaded, they're still ready to step up as the last line of defense in a city rotten to the core with vice and corruption. Their goal? Liberate Heywood from El Chamuco Endiablado - an S.O.B. like no other - and his merciless goons.

You won't find any deep meaning here: it's a straight run 'n' gun, shoot 'em up, race against time to drop as many gangers as you can. That a problem? Didn't think so! 'Cause it's the best part of the game! And let's not forget the preem retrowave soundtrack that gives Big Trouble in Little Heywood its distinctive flair.

No matter how you slice it, in virtual Heywood YOU are the one dishing out justice and leaving ganger corpses in your wake. As opposed to the real Heywood, where... well, you know how it is. And now you can see why this game is experiencing a resurgence in popularity unseen since its original release. It even snagged the honor of being voted our "Game of the Week", surpassing even the likes of all-time hits like Interstellar Commander 6!

title: INTERSTELLAR COMMANDER 6: Saving the Galaxy… Again!
text:
Pixel Fortress: The legendary Interstellar Commander series is BACK! After years of anticipation fans can once again board the Burgundy and travel at light speed to save the galaxy. But can the sixth installment of this beloved franchise still pack the same "oomph"? Or has it devolved into a lukewarm pile of "meh"? We've got the answer!

Interstellar Commander 6: The Hunt for Baron Octavian still has everything that made us gush the series' previous entries. Spectacular battles on dazzling space stations? Check! Exploration of jaw-dropping exoplanets? You got it! Shocking plot twists? Affirmative! Yes, the controversial ending has been hard for some die-hard fans to swallow, but you'll have to experience it for yourself.

Your mission: to track down the infamous, yet charismatic Baron Octavian who ticks all the boxes of a villain on a galactic scale. Our interaction with him largely depends on whether we go down the Paladin or the Scoundrel path. Multiple playthroughs are well worth the chance to discover the many facets of Octavian! It's just too bad the devs didn't make him into a romance option... but hey, that's what mods are for, right?

Speaking of romance, we should emphasize that this adventure isn't just a rollercoaster ride of emotions, but also gives opportunities to really, erm... form deeper connections with your crewmembers and strengthen bonds with previous characters from the franchise.

The popularity of a certain braindance of dubious quality and origin (relive at your own peril) which lets you find out whether the Burgundy's cannon is a worthy substitute for a bed (spoiler: it isn't), leads us to believe players of all genders and tastes will be pleased. Especially given the return of all-time favorite Garriux, who hasn't lost an ounce of enthusiasm for carrying out his, ahem, calibrations...

Long story short, hunting down Baron Octavian across the universe is going to be helluva good time for all diehard fans of the series. As for you new potential players out there, how will you feel in the commander's polished space boots? Confident and capable, we hope! After all, the galaxy won't save itself!

title: FEUDAL PEASANT SIMULATOR 3: Serf's Up!
text:
Pixel Fortress: A title we never asked for, and a title we don't deserve. Indie French studio Château de Rais has returned us once again to the pitiable fate of the medieval peasant. While the previous two installments were criticized for clumsy gameplay and overall lack of realism (and rightly so, we all remember the infamous "path of the fire shaman"), the franchise's creators have learned from these difficult lessons. They now invite players to experience "the harshest autumn of the Middle Ages" using a revamped VR system. After several hours of early-access gameplay, we can confirm – this is no mere marketing ploy.

Let's start with the fact that FPS3 offers only one difficulty setting: "Sick & Feeble". The in-game tasks themselves seem relatively straightforward. Hauling sacks of grain and buckets of shit from place to place was right in my character's wheelhouse from the get-go. Grooming horses, digging ditches, pitching tents in peat bogs, on the other hand... not so much. And this game shows no mercy. The tiniest slip-up and you're at the end of a whip or under your lord's boot. Also, the fact that the NPCs speak exclusively in Old French or Latin doesn't make things any easier. Turn on the subtitles, you say? Sorry, there aren't any. Peasants are illiterate, after all.

Now a quick word about the highly touted world exploration system. All map traversal takes place in real time. Now, technically you play as a serf, bound to your lord's estate. You can try to hide yourself in an outgoing wagon, covered in horse manure. If you do and are discovered, you guessed it – crack of the whip. Great, you're at low health, but eating the moldy bread and rotten turnips in your inventory doesn't help. All that gave you was dysentery. BUT, this is where the realism and world reactivity shine. Dysentery means frequent trips to the bushes. Hiding in a bush helped me set a survival PR of 5 hours. Of course, in the end, I was still flogged to death by some noble French asshole who had a lot to say (mean things, I assume).

Ultimately, Feudal Peasant Simulator 3 presents an interesting question: At what point does suffering in a sim go from fun times to genuinely insufferable times? I don't exactly know how this is possible, but I think this game actually gave me real-world back problems. 10/10, would play again. This title is a must have for history buffs with masochistic tendencies. Knowledge of Old French recommended.

American Animal Defenders' Association: The transfer also includes a small bonus for your diligent attempt at helping us locate the elusive violet rosefinch. We will do everything we can to protect this beautiful, endangered bird.
